example.en: The city park is huge, so we rode bikes around it.
example.zh: 這個城市公園很大，所以我們騎腳踏車繞了一圈。

example.en: He was late for work because of a car accident on the highway.
example.zh: 他因為高速公路上發生車禍而上班遲到。

example.en: My sister studied abroad in Japan for one year.
example.zh: 我姊姊在日本留學了一年。

example.en: My grandfather can repair almost any broken chair in the house.
example.zh: 我爺爺幾乎能修好家裡任何壞掉的椅子。

example.en: I almost didn't recognize my old friend because he had short hair now.
example.zh: 我差點認不出我的老朋友，因為他現在頭髮剪短了。

example.en: She wants to apply for a job at the new hotel downtown.
example.zh: 她想去市區新開的飯店應徵工作。

example.en: If we turn off unused lights, we can reduce our electricity bill.
example.zh: 如果我們把沒在用的燈關掉，就能減少電費。

example.en: We will celebrate my mother's birthday with a big dinner tonight.
example.zh: 今晚我們會用一頓豐盛的晚餐來慶祝媽媽的生日。

example.en: I trust my best friend, so I always tell her my secrets.
example.zh: 我很信任我最好的朋友，所以我總是把秘密告訴她。

example.en: Let's search the kitchen again, because the car keys must be here.
example.zh: 我們再找一次廚房吧，車鑰匙一定在這裡。

example.en: Our class schedule changed, so Monday's lesson now starts at ten.
example.zh: 我們的課表改了，所以星期一的課現在十點開始。

example.en: The weather was terrible yesterday, so our picnic was canceled.
example.zh: 昨天天氣很糟，所以我們的野餐取消了。

example.en: The photo on my phone shows a clear image of the mountain.
example.zh: 我手機裡的照片清楚拍出了那座山的影像。

example.en: I want to apologize for being late to the meeting this morning.
example.zh: 我想為今天早上開會遲到向大家道歉。

example.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious injuries when you ride a bike.
example.zh: 騎腳踏車時戴安全帽可以預防嚴重的傷害。

example.en: The rapid development of the city has brought many new shops and jobs.
example.zh: 這座城市快速發展，帶來了許多新商店和工作機會。

example.en: Could you introduce yourself to the class before we start?
example.zh: 我們開始之前，可以請你向全班介紹一下自己嗎？

example.en: My first task at the new office is to answer customer emails.
example.zh: 我在新辦公室的第一項工作是回覆客戶的電子郵件。

example.en: My little brother is very creative and loves drawing funny monsters.
example.zh: 我弟弟很有創意，喜歡畫有趣的怪獸。

example.en: Please stay calm and tell me what happened at the station.
example.zh: 請保持冷靜，告訴我在車站發生了什麼事。

example.en: After five hours on the bus, we finally reached our destination.
example.zh: 坐了五個小時的公車後，我們終於抵達目的地。

example.en: Don't blame the kids for breaking the vase; it was an accident.
example.zh: 別責怪孩子打破花瓶，那只是意外。

example.en: We had a short conversation about movies while waiting for the bus.
example.zh: 我們在等公車時聊了一下電影。

example.en: Children develop their language skills quickly when they read books every day.
example.zh: 孩子每天閱讀書籍時，語言能力會發展得很快。

example.en: He refused to eat the spicy soup because it was too hot for him.
example.zh: 他拒絕喝那碗辣湯，因為對他來說太辣了。

example.en: My boss always treats new employees with kindness.
example.zh: 我們老闆總是很親切地對待新進員工。

example.en: This job offers a great opportunity to learn new skills.
example.zh: 這份工作提供學習新技能的好機會。

example.en: This new medicine is effective against the common cold.
example.zh: 這種新藥對一般感冒很有效。

example.en: The school organizes outdoor activities every spring for students.
example.zh: 學校每年春天都會為學生舉辦戶外活動。

example.en: Can you describe the person who called you this morning?
example.zh: 你可以描述今天早上打電話給你的那個人嗎？

example.en: I nearly missed the bus because I woke up late.
example.zh: 我因為睡過頭，差點錯過公車。

example.en: She decided to accept the job offer from the new company.
example.zh: 她決定接受那家新公司的工作邀約。

example.en: Learning to cook healthy meals has been a real challenge for me.
example.zh: 學會煮健康餐對我來說真的是一大挑戰。

example.en: Even though I was busy, I managed to finish the report on time.
example.zh: 雖然很忙，我還是設法準時完成報告。

example.en: The government plans to build a new hospital in our city.
example.zh: 政府計畫在我們城市蓋一間新醫院。

example.en: Please consider my suggestion before you make the final decision.
example.zh: 做最後決定前，請考慮一下我的建議。

example.en: Her main concern is whether her son is eating well at school.
example.zh: 她最擔心的是兒子在學校有沒有好好吃飯。

example.en: I have a job interview at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我明天早上十點有一場工作面試。

example.en: I read an interesting article about healthy sleep habits yesterday.
example.zh: 我昨天讀了一篇關於健康睡眠習慣的有趣文章。

example.en: Every employee must wear a name badge when entering the building.
example.zh: 每位員工進入大樓時都必須佩戴名牌。

example.en: Could you recommend a good restaurant near the train station?
example.zh: 你能推薦火車站附近的好餐廳嗎？

example.en: Please wait a moment while I check the schedule.
example.zh: 請稍等一下，我查一下行程表。

example.en: Before you sign the contract, read every page carefully.
example.zh: 簽約前，請仔細閱讀每一頁條款。

example.en: My doctor said I should change my diet and eat more vegetables.
example.zh: 醫生說我應該改變飲食，多吃蔬菜。

example.en: Living near the office has the advantage of a short commute.
example.zh: 住在辦公室附近的好處是通勤時間短。

example.en: Good friends are of great value to me in difficult times.
example.zh: 在困難時期，好朋友對我來說非常寶貴。

example.en: The manager asked us to finish the project before Friday.
example.zh: 經理要求我們在星期五前完成專案。

example.en: She has the ability to speak three languages fluently.
example.zh: 她有能力流利地說三種語言。

example.en: This old book is worth reading, so please borrow it.
example.zh: 這本舊書值得一讀，你可以借去看。

example.en: Please complete the form and return it to the front desk.
example.zh: 請填寫表格並交回櫃檯。

example.en: I really hate waiting in long lines at the bank.
example.zh: 我真的很討厭在銀行排長隊。

example.en: If you work hard, you can achieve your goals this year.
example.zh: 只要努力工作，你今年就能達成目標。

example.en: The restaurant charges double the usual price on holidays.
example.zh: 這家餐廳在假日收取平常兩倍的價格。

example.en: Could you bring me the bill, please?
example.zh: 能請你把帳單拿來給我嗎？

example.en: Her parents had a strong influence on her career choice.
example.zh: 她的父母對她的職業選擇有很大的影響。

example.en: We often walk our dog around the neighborhood after dinner.
example.zh: 晚餐後我們常帶狗在社區附近散步。

example.en: She received a higher salary after her promotion last year.
example.zh: 她去年升職後薪水變高了。

example.en: The new law had a big impact on small businesses.
example.zh: 這項新法律對小企業造成很大衝擊。

example.en: I understand your situation, and I want to help you.
example.zh: 我了解你的處境，我想幫你。

example.en: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her song.
example.zh: 歌手唱完歌後，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

example.en: Whether we go hiking depends on the weather tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們明天去不去爬山，要看天氣而定。

example.en: I have a dentist appointment at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我明天早上十點有牙醫預約。

example.en: I didn't realize how late it was until I looked at the clock.
example.zh: 直到看了時鐘，我才意識到已經這麼晚了。

example.en: It is important to express your feelings honestly to friends.
example.zh: 向朋友誠實表達你的感受很重要。

example.en: Can I borrow your umbrella until the rain stops?
example.zh: 我可以借你的傘，等雨停再還嗎？

example.en: Air pollution in the city has become a serious problem.
example.zh: 這座城市的空氣污染已經成為嚴重問題。

example.en: It is polite to say thank you after receiving a gift.
example.zh: 收到禮物後說聲謝謝是有禮貌的。

example.en: The lawyer met with a client at her office this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上律師在辦公室和一位客戶會面。

example.en: Please contact our office if you have any questions.
example.zh: 如果有任何問題，請聯絡我們的辦公室。

example.en: Practicing every day will help you improve your English.
example.zh: 每天練習會幫助你提升英文。

example.en: I need to pack my suitcase before the trip tomorrow.
example.zh: 明天出發前我得把行李箱收拾好。

example.en: This old temple was built more than a century ago.
example.zh: 這座古寺是一百多年前建造的。

example.en: Her monthly income is enough to pay the rent.
example.zh: 她每個月的收入足夠付房租。

example.en: Cooking is a useful skill that everyone should learn.
example.zh: 烹飪是每個人都該學的實用技能。

example.en: The students were nervous before their piano performance.
example.zh: 學生們在鋼琴表演前都很緊張。

example.en: My grandmother eats vegetables every day to stay healthy.
example.zh: 我祖母每天吃蔬菜來保持健康。

example.en: The customer complained that the coffee was cold.
example.zh: 那位顧客抱怨咖啡是冷的。

example.en: The courier will deliver our package before noon tomorrow.
example.zh: 快遞員明天中午前會把我們的包裹送到。

example.en: This restaurant is famous for the high quality of its food.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以食物品質優良聞名。

example.en: Our flight to Tokyo leaves at seven in the morning.
example.zh: 我們飛往東京的班機早上七點起飛。

example.en: Please do not share your personal information with strangers online.
example.zh: 請不要在網路上把個人資料分享給陌生人。

example.en: I expect the new manager to arrive before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 我預期新主管會在會議開始前抵達。

example.en: The hotel offers free breakfast to all guests every morning.
example.zh: 這家飯店每天早上都免費提供早餐給所有房客。

example.en: The doctor spent extra time explaining the treatment to the patient.
example.zh: 醫生花了更多時間向病人解釋治療方式。

example.en: We went hiking to enjoy the beauty of nature.
example.zh: 我們去健行，享受大自然的美景。

example.en: Twelve teams joined the national singing competition this year.
example.zh: 今年有十二支隊伍參加全國歌唱比賽。

example.en: We bought tickets to a rock concert for next Saturday.
example.zh: 我們買了下週六搖滾演唱會的票。

example.en: Many young people cannot afford to buy a house in the city.
example.zh: 許多年輕人買不起市區的房子。

example.en: Too much work can cause stress and make you tired.
example.zh: 工作太多會造成壓力，讓人很累。

example.en: She presented her research at an international conference in Paris.
example.zh: 她在巴黎的一場國際研討會上發表研究。

example.en: We tried a local dish that is only sold in this small town.
example.zh: 我們嚐了只有這個小鎮才買得到的當地料理。

example.en: The company made a major change to its work schedule.
example.zh: 公司對工作時程做了重大調整。

example.en: I made a dinner reservation for two people at seven.
example.zh: 我預約了七點兩人的晚餐位子。

example.en: In general, people in this city are friendly to visitors.
example.zh: 一般來說，這座城市的人對遊客很友善。

example.en: The teacher gave everyone a fair chance to answer the question.
example.zh: 老師給每個人公平回答問題的機會。

example.en: This brand of shoes is popular among young people.
example.zh: 這個品牌的鞋子在年輕人之間很受歡迎。

example.en: Good education helps children prepare for their future careers.
example.zh: 良好的教育能幫助孩子為未來的職業做準備。

example.en: Is this room still available for next weekend?
example.zh: 下週末這間房間還有空嗎？

example.en: My parents live in a modern apartment near the train station.
example.zh: 我爸媽住在火車站附近的一間現代公寓。

example.en: The two students exchanged phone numbers after the class ended.
example.zh: 下課後，兩位同學交換了電話號碼。

example.en: Her natural curiosity led her to explore the old library.
example.zh: 她天生的好奇心讓她去探索那座老圖書館。

example.en: We plan to attend the wedding on Saturday afternoon.
example.zh: 我們打算週六下午參加那場婚禮。

example.en: He studied hard but still failed the driving test.
example.zh: 他很用功，但還是沒通過駕照考試。

example.en: The new computer system makes it easier to check orders.
example.zh: 新的電腦系統讓查詢訂單變得更容易。

example.en: Can you handle this customer complaint for me today?
example.zh: 今天可以請你幫我處理這個客訴嗎？

example.en: Do you want to pay in cash or by card?
example.zh: 你要用現金還是刷卡付款？

example.en: The students will perform a short play at the school festival.
example.zh: 學生們將在學校的園遊會上演出一齣短劇。

example.en: Don't waste your time watching videos before the exam.
example.zh: 考試前別浪費時間看影片。

example.en: Our sales target for this month is one thousand units.
example.zh: 我們這個月的銷售目標是一千件。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof of our house.
example.zh: 那場暴風雨讓我們家的屋頂受到嚴重損壞。

example.en: Her knowledge of history helped her win the quiz.
example.zh: 她的歷史知識幫她贏得了那場問答比賽。

example.en: I am certain that the bus leaves at eight.
example.zh: 我確定公車八點出發。

example.en: With a little effort, you can finish the puzzle today.
example.zh: 只要稍微努力，你今天就能完成這個拼圖。

example.en: The team spent two years on research about sleep habits.
example.zh: 這個團隊花了兩年研究睡眠習慣。

example.en: Thanks for your kind comment on my photo today.
example.zh: 謝謝你今天在我的照片下留下的善意留言。

example.en: I go to the gym on a regular basis.
example.zh: 我定期去健身房運動。

example.en: The passenger waited at the station for the late train.
example.zh: 那位乘客在車站等待誤點的火車。

example.en: Please tell me the amount of money you need.
example.zh: 請告訴我你需要的金額。

example.en: Public transportation in this city is fast and cheap.
example.zh: 這個城市的大眾交通又快又便宜。

example.en: One benefit of walking to work is saving money.
example.zh: 走路上班的一個好處是省錢。

example.en: Can you tell me the direction to the train station?
example.zh: 你可以告訴我去火車站的方向嗎？

example.en: Modern technology has changed how we communicate with friends.
example.zh: 現代科技改變了我們與朋友聯絡的方式。

example.en: She applied for a sales position at the new store.
example.zh: 她應徵新店的業務職位。

example.en: He needs medical care after the bike accident.
example.zh: 他騎車出事後需要醫療照護。

example.en: The old house lacks a proper kitchen and bathroom.
example.zh: 這間老房子缺少像樣的廚房和浴室。

example.en: I want to download this app before my trip.
example.zh: 我想在旅行前下載這個應用程式。

example.en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
example.zh: 你可以把傘借我到明天嗎？

example.en: My parents often disagree with me about my schedule.
example.zh: 我父母常常對我的行程看法和我不同。

example.en: The result of the exam will be announced next week.
example.zh: 考試結果將在下週公布。

example.en: My family has a tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
example.zh: 我們家有除夕吃水餃的傳統。

example.en: Drinking a glass of water every morning is a good habit.
example.zh: 每天早上喝一杯水是個好習慣。

example.en: We will cancel the picnic unless the weather improves.
example.zh: 除非天氣變好，否則我們會取消野餐。

example.en: If you practice every day, you will succeed in learning English.
example.zh: 如果每天練習，你就會學好英文。

example.en: This factory can produce thousands of phones every day.
example.zh: 這間工廠每天可以生產數千支手機。

example.en: It is important to communicate clearly with your coworkers.
example.zh: 和同事清楚溝通很重要。

example.en: I didn't want coffee, so I ordered tea instead.
example.zh: 我不想喝咖啡，所以改點了茶。

example.en: Please connect your phone to the Wi-Fi network.
example.zh: 請把你的手機連上無線網路。

example.en: My friend suggested a new restaurant near the station.
example.zh: 我朋友建議車站附近的一家新餐廳。

example.en: I always feel nervous before a job interview.
example.zh: 面試前我總是會覺得緊張。

example.en: The country's economy grew quickly last year.
example.zh: 這個國家的經濟去年成長很快。

example.en: The temperature in the room is too high for me.
example.zh: 房間的溫度對我來說太高了。

example.en: It is hard to keep a good balance between work and rest.
example.zh: 要在工作和休息之間保持良好平衡很難。

example.en: The deadline for the report is this Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 這份報告的截止期限是這週五下午。

example.en: Math is my favorite subject at school.
example.zh: 數學是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

example.en: You should avoid eating too much sugar every day.
example.zh: 你每天應該避免吃太多糖。

example.en: My teacher gave me good advice about studying abroad.
example.zh: 老師給了我關於出國留學的好建議。

example.en: She didn't mention the problem during the meeting.
example.zh: 她在會議中沒有提到那個問題。

example.en: Our community organizes a cleanup event every spring.
example.zh: 我們社區每年春天都會舉辦清潔活動。

example.en: The price of vegetables may increase during winter.
example.zh: 冬天蔬菜的價格可能會上漲。

example.en: We need to replace the broken light bulb in the kitchen.
example.zh: 我們需要更換廚房裡壞掉的燈泡。

example.en: The subway is always crowded during the morning rush hour.
example.zh: 早上尖峰時段的捷運總是非常擁擠。

example.en: Lack of sleep can have a bad effect on your mood.
example.zh: 睡眠不足會對你的心情造成不好的影響。

example.en: She has five years of experience working as a nurse.
example.zh: 她有五年當護理師的工作經驗。

example.en: Everyone over eighteen can vote in the local election.
example.zh: 十八歲以上的人都可以在地方選舉中投票。

example.en: The new store is in a great location near the station.
example.zh: 這家新店位於車站附近，地點很好。

example.en: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.
example.zh: 抽菸會增加罹患心臟病的風險。

example.en: In my opinion, this restaurant serves the best noodles in town.
example.zh: 依我的看法，這家餐廳的麵是全城最好吃的。

example.en: About fifty percent of the students passed the English test.
example.zh: 大約百分之五十的學生通過了英文測驗。

example.en: The old street is so narrow that only one car can pass.
example.zh: 這條老街非常狹窄，一次只能過一輛車。

example.en: There was heavy traffic on the highway, so I was late.
example.zh: 高速公路上車流很大，所以我遲到了。

example.en: Tom is responsible for organizing the team meeting every week.
example.zh: 湯姆負責每週籌辦團隊會議。

example.en: Please bring an extra pair of socks in case your shoes get wet.
example.zh: 請帶一雙額外的襪子，以防鞋子弄濕。

example.en: He chose to ignore the message because he was busy.
example.zh: 他因為很忙，所以選擇不理會那則訊息。

example.en: These shoes are very comfortable, so I can walk all day.
example.zh: 這雙鞋非常舒適，所以我可以整天走路。

example.en: You need to create an account before you can order online.
example.zh: 你必須先建立帳號，才能線上訂購。

example.en: I read the online review before I booked the hotel.
example.zh: 我訂飯店之前先看了線上評論。

example.en: The doctor can identify the cause of your headache.
example.zh: 醫生可以找出你頭痛的原因。

example.en: She changed her career from teaching to graphic design.
example.zh: 她的職業從教書轉為平面設計。

example.en: The population of this small town is about five thousand.
example.zh: 這個小鎮的人口大約五千人。

example.en: Every human needs food, water, and sleep to survive.
example.zh: 每個人都需要食物、水和睡眠才能生存。

example.en: My business partner and I opened a coffee shop last year.
example.zh: 我和生意夥伴去年開了一家咖啡店。

example.en: Doctors are working hard to find a cure for this disease.
example.zh: 醫生們正努力尋找這種疾病的治療方法。

example.en: I love the simple design of this modern kitchen.
example.zh: 我很喜歡這間現代廚房簡約的設計。

example.en: My parents always support me when I make difficult choices.
example.zh: 每當我做出艱難的決定時，父母總是支持我。

example.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
example.zh: 這個藥每天飯後吃兩次。

example.en: The price of the hotel room does include breakfast.
example.zh: 這間飯店房間的價格確實包含早餐。

example.en: My goal this year is to save enough money for a trip.
example.zh: 我今年的目標是存夠錢去旅行。

example.en: Please pay attention to the teacher during the lesson.
example.zh: 上課時請專心聽老師講課。

example.en: She always has a positive attitude, even when it rains.
example.zh: 即使下雨，她總是保持正面的態度。

example.en: The students need art material for their class project.
example.zh: 學生們的美術課專案需要一些材料。

example.en: The owner of this small café greets every customer with a smile.
example.zh: 這家小咖啡店的老闆會對每位客人微笑打招呼。

example.en: The customer asked the clerk where the shoes were.
example.zh: 顧客問店員鞋子在哪裡。

example.en: Please bring your ID and the signed document to the office.
example.zh: 請把你的身分證和簽好的文件帶到辦公室。

example.en: The average temperature in summer here is very high.
example.zh: 這裡夏天的平均氣溫非常高。

example.en: The police are looking for the people who committed the crime.
example.zh: 警方正在尋找犯下這起罪行的人。

example.en: The new restaurant tries to satisfy every guest who visits.
example.zh: 這家新餐廳努力讓每位來訪的客人都滿意。

example.en: After a good night's sleep, I always have plenty of energy.
example.zh: 睡了一個好覺後，我總是精力充沛。

example.en: My son likes to collect stamps from different countries.
example.zh: 我兒子喜歡收集來自不同國家的郵票。

example.en: The weather is perfect for a picnic in the park today.
example.zh: 今天的天氣非常適合去公園野餐。

example.en: Only a few cookies remain on the plate after the party.
example.zh: 派對結束後，盤子上只剩下幾片餅乾。

example.en: Her presentation about climate change impressed the whole class.
example.zh: 她關於氣候變遷的簡報讓全班都印象深刻。

example.en: The hotel staff helped us find a taxi at midnight.
example.zh: 飯店員工在半夜幫我們叫到計程車。

example.en: The tourism industry in this town employs many local people.
example.zh: 這個小鎮的觀光產業僱用了很多當地人。

example.en: Could you explain how to use this new washing machine?
example.zh: 你可以解釋一下這台新洗衣機要怎麼用嗎？

example.en: There is a speed limit of fifty kilometers on this road.
example.zh: 這條路的速限是每小時五十公里。

example.en: My brother earns extra money by walking dogs on weekends.
example.zh: 我哥哥週末遛狗來賺外快。

example.en: The school holds a sports event every spring for all students.
example.zh: 學校每年春天都會為全體學生舉辦運動會。

example.en: Your attitude toward work really affects how others see you.
example.zh: 你對工作的態度會真的影響別人怎麼看你。

example.en: Please do not read my private messages without asking first.
example.zh: 請先問過我，不要看我的私人訊息。

example.en: Each item in this store is marked with a clear price.
example.zh: 這家店裡每件商品都標示清楚的價格。

example.en: I need to focus on my homework tonight.
example.zh: 我今晚得專心寫功課。

example.en: You need to bring necessary documents to the office.
example.zh: 你到辦公室時必須帶上必要的文件。

example.en: Everyone makes mistakes, so don't worry too much.
example.zh: 人都會犯錯，所以別太擔心。

example.en: The doctor checked my medical record before the surgery.
example.zh: 醫生在手術前查看了我的病歷紀錄。

example.en: We rent a small apartment near the train station.
example.zh: 我們租了一間靠近火車站的小公寓。

example.en: She earned a degree in engineering from a local university.
example.zh: 她在當地大學取得工程學學位。

example.en: Her heart rate is normal after a short rest.
example.zh: 休息一下後，她的心跳恢復正常。

example.en: Please remind me to call my mom tonight.
example.zh: 請提醒我今晚打電話給媽媽。

example.en: The sign warns drivers about slippery roads ahead.
example.zh: 標誌提醒駕駛前方路滑。

example.en: My library book is due next Monday, so I must return it.
example.zh: 我借的圖書館書下週一到期，所以必須還書。

example.en: Lack of sleep can affect your mood and concentration.
example.zh: 睡眠不足可能會影響你的心情和專注力。

example.en: Choosing a major was a difficult choice for me.
example.zh: 對我來說，選擇主修是個困難的抉擇。

example.en: The hotel charges a small fee for parking.
example.zh: 飯店停車要收取一筆小額費用。

example.en: Could you confirm your flight time before we leave?
example.zh: 我們出發前，你可以確認班機時間嗎？

example.en: She felt confident about her speech after practicing many times.
example.zh: 練習很多次後，她對自己的演講很有信心。

example.en: This song sounds familiar, but I can't remember the name.
example.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起歌名。

example.en: Sorry to bother you, but could you open the door?
example.zh: 不好意思打擾你，可以幫我開一下門嗎？

example.en: I wrote the dentist appointment on my calendar.
example.zh: 我把看牙醫的時間寫在行事曆上。

example.en: We need to solve this problem before the meeting.
example.zh: 開會前我們得解決這個問題。

example.en: Tickets cost twenty dollars for adults and ten for children.
example.zh: 成人票二十美元，兒童票十美元。

example.en: Many students feel a lot of pressure before final exams.
example.zh: 許多學生在期末考前會感到很大的壓力。

example.en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
example.zh: 可以幫我個忙，替我澆一下植物嗎？

example.en: The city council discussed the traffic issue at the meeting.
example.zh: 市議會在會議上討論了交通問題。

example.en: Good communication is important in any healthy relationship.
example.zh: 良好的溝通對任何健康的關係都很重要。

example.en: The old car is in good condition for its age.
example.zh: 這輛老車以它的年份來說狀況不錯。

example.en: The tourist took many photos of the old castle.
example.zh: 那位遊客拍了很多古堡的照片。

example.en: This job requires strong communication skills.
example.zh: 這份工作需要很強的溝通能力。

example.en: My new phone is similar to my old one.
example.zh: 我的新手機和舊的很像。

example.en: I found the recipe on a cooking website.
example.zh: 我在一個料理網站上找到這個食譜。

example.en: She uses a simple method to remember new words.
example.zh: 她用一個簡單的方法記新單字。

example.en: Can I pay for lunch with a credit card?
example.zh: 我可以用信用卡付午餐錢嗎？

example.en: I have a sharp pain in my knee.
example.zh: 我膝蓋有一陣劇痛。

example.en: I took the usual bus to school this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上搭平常那班公車去學校。

example.en: We discovered a small café near the station.
example.zh: 我們在車站附近發現一間小咖啡館。

example.en: She is preparing dinner for her family tonight.
example.zh: 她今晚正在為家人準備晚餐。

example.en: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
example.zh: 早上我比較喜歡喝茶而不是咖啡。

example.en: A package arrived at my door this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午有個包裹送到我家門口。

example.en: The manager has to deal with many complaints.
example.zh: 經理必須處理許多客訴。

example.en: Japan is a nation famous for its trains.
example.zh: 日本是一個以火車聞名的國家。

example.en: The airline cancelled our flight because of the storm.
example.zh: 因為暴風雨，航空公司取消了我們的班機。

example.en: My colleague helped me finish the report.
example.zh: 同事幫我完成了報告。

example.en: I really appreciate your help with my move.
example.zh: 我真的很感謝你幫我搬家。

example.en: The subway station is convenient for my commute.
example.zh: 地鐵站對我通勤很方便。

example.en: My brothers always argue about who gets the remote.
example.zh: 我兄弟們總是為了誰能拿遙控器而吵架。

example.en: Are you aware of the new parking rules?
example.zh: 你知道新的停車規定嗎？

example.en: Call 119 if there is a medical emergency.
example.zh: 如果發生緊急醫療狀況，請撥打119。

example.en: My sister will graduate from university next June.
example.zh: 我姊姊明年六月大學畢業。

example.en: We should protect the environment for future generations.
example.zh: 我們應該為後代子孫保護環境。

example.en: The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
example.zh: 這個計畫聽起來不錯，然而花費太高。

example.en: Airport security checked every bag carefully.
example.zh: 機場安檢仔細檢查了每個行李。

example.en: She has a kind character and always helps her friends.
example.zh: 她個性善良，總是幫助朋友。

example.en: Package delivery usually takes three days in this city.
example.zh: 這座城市的包裹配送通常需要三天。

example.en: Please remove your shoes before you enter the house.
example.zh: 進屋前請先脫掉鞋子。

example.en: I made a request for a quiet room at the hotel.
example.zh: 我向飯店要求一間安靜的房間。

example.en: Have you seen any recent news about the new bridge?
example.zh: 你有看到關於新橋的最近新聞嗎？

example.en: The climate here is warm and dry most of the year.
example.zh: 這裡一年大部分時間氣候溫暖乾燥。

example.en: Wearing a helmet is important for your safety when cycling.
example.zh: 騎自行車時戴安全帽對你的安全很重要。

example.en: We finally found a solution to the traffic problem.
example.zh: 我們終於找到解決交通問題的方法。

example.en: Please fill out this form and return it to the office.
example.zh: 請填寫這份表格並交回辦公室。

example.en: It is hard to compare these two phones because they are different.
example.zh: 這兩支手機不同，很難比較。

example.en: She remembered every detail of the trip to Japan.
example.zh: 她記得日本之旅的每一個細節。

example.en: The doctor said the injury is serious, so you must rest.
example.zh: 醫生說傷勢很嚴重，所以你必須休息。

example.en: I love fresh fruit, especially mangoes in the summer.
example.zh: 我喜歡新鮮水果，尤其是夏天的芒果。

example.en: My grandfather stays active by walking in the park every morning.
example.zh: 我爺爺每天早上在公園散步，保持活力。

example.en: Don't forget to bring your passport when you travel abroad.
example.zh: 出國旅遊時別忘了帶護照。

example.en: The heavy rain may delay our flight to Tokyo.
example.zh: 大雨可能會延誤我們飛往東京的班機。

example.en: He is honest, so he always tells me the truth.
example.zh: 他很誠實，所以總是跟我說實話。

example.en: This old watch is valuable because it belonged to my grandmother.
example.zh: 這只舊手錶很貴重，因為它是我奶奶的。

example.en: The school does not allow students to use phones in class.
example.zh: 學校不允許學生在課堂上使用手機。

example.en: Her polite behavior at the dinner impressed everyone.
example.zh: 她在晚餐上的禮貌舉止讓大家印象深刻。

example.en: The restaurant plans to hire ten new workers this month.
example.zh: 這家餐廳計畫本月雇用十名新員工。

example.en: The interest rate at this bank is lower than last year.
example.zh: 這家銀行的利率比去年低。

example.en: The distance from my home to the station is about two kilometers.
example.zh: 我家到車站的距離大約兩公里。

example.en: The price of this hotel is reasonable for a family trip.
example.zh: 這家飯店的價格對家庭旅遊來說很合理。

example.en: We are planning a summer vacation at the beach this year.
example.zh: 我們今年打算去海邊過暑假。

example.en: She made a quick decision to take the earlier train.
example.zh: 她很快做了決定，搭較早的那班火車。

example.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my sister.
example.zh: 這把藍色雨傘是我妹妹的。

example.en: The new project will involve many people from different departments.
example.zh: 這個新專案將牽涉許多不同部門的人。

example.en: We had a delicious meal at the night market.
example.zh: 我們在夜市吃了一頓美味的餐點。

example.en: Social media helps people share news quickly every day.
example.zh: 社群媒體幫助人們每天快速分享新聞。

example.en: Please make your payment before the end of this month.
example.zh: 請在本月底前完成付款。

example.en: The shoe store is offering a twenty percent discount this weekend.
example.zh: 這家鞋店這個週末提供八折優惠。

example.en: The hotel will charge us extra for breakfast.
example.zh: 飯店會另外向我們收取早餐費用。

example.en: The staff at the information desk were very helpful.
example.zh: 服務台的工作人員非常樂於助人。

example.en: Please reply to my email as soon as possible.
example.zh: 請盡快回覆我的電子郵件。

example.en: A small rainbow appeared after the afternoon rain.
example.zh: 午後下完雨，天空出現了一道小彩虹。

example.en: We need to set a monthly budget for groceries.
example.zh: 我們需要為每月的買菜錢訂定預算。

example.en: Let's discuss the travel plan during lunch today.
example.zh: 我們今天午餐時來討論旅遊計畫吧。

example.en: The shop will be closed for a short period during the holiday.
example.zh: 這家店在假期間會暫停營業一小段時間。

example.en: Students should respect their teachers and classmates.
example.zh: 學生應該尊重老師和同學。

example.en: I still have a happy memory of our summer trip.
example.zh: 我對我們的暑假旅行還留著快樂的回憶。

example.en: After work, I like to relax with a cup of tea.
example.zh: 下班後，我喜歡泡杯茶來放鬆一下。

example.en: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
example.zh: 我的父母總是鼓勵我嘗試新事物。

example.en: We had an outdoor picnic in the park on Sunday.
example.zh: 星期天我們在公園野餐。

example.en: Young people today use technology differently from their parents' generation.
example.zh: 現在的年輕人使用科技的方式和父母那一代不同。

example.en: Too much negative news can make people feel anxious.
example.zh: 太多負面新聞會讓人感到焦慮。

example.en: The advertisement on the bus was very funny.
example.zh: 公車上的那則廣告非常有趣。

example.en: Please recycle these plastic bottles instead of throwing them away.
example.zh: 請把這些塑膠瓶回收，不要丟掉。

example.en: I intend to finish this report before Friday.
example.zh: 我打算在星期五前完成這份報告。

example.en: My morning routine includes exercise and a healthy breakfast.
example.zh: 我的晨間例行公事包括運動和健康的早餐。

example.en: My little sister is very intelligent and learns new words quickly.
example.zh: 我妹妹非常聰明，學新單字學得很快。

example.en: The weather was awful, so we stayed inside all day.
example.zh: 天氣糟透了，我們整天待在屋裡。

example.en: Price is an important factor when I choose a restaurant.
example.zh: 價格是我選餐廳時很重要的因素。

example.en: The new shopping mall attracts many young people every weekend.
example.zh: 這間新購物中心每個週末都吸引很多年輕人。

example.en: He felt guilty after he forgot his mother's birthday.
example.zh: 忘了媽媽的生日後，他覺得很內疚。

example.en: This old machine still operates well even after twenty years.
example.zh: 這台老機器用了二十年，還是運作得很好。

example.en: A tall man slowly approached us at the bus stop.
example.zh: 一位高個子男子在公車站慢慢走向我們。

example.en: Can you help me locate the nearest subway station on this map?
example.zh: 你能幫我在這張地圖上找到最近的捷運站嗎？

example.en: The taxi fare to the airport is about five hundred dollars.
example.zh: 搭計程車到機場的車費大約五百元。

example.en: We saw camels walking across the hot desert during our trip.
example.zh: 旅途中我們看到駱駝走過炎熱的沙漠。

example.en: The calm lake reflects the mountains and the blue sky.
example.zh: 平靜的湖面倒映出山和藍天。

example.en: My parents are worried about our financial situation this year.
example.zh: 我父母很擔心今年我們家的財務狀況。

example.en: It took him two weeks to recover from the flu.
example.zh: 他花了兩週才從流感中康復。

example.en: Each handmade bag in this shop has a unique design.
example.zh: 這家店的每個手工包都有獨特的設計。

example.en: I was so tired after work that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
example.zh: 下班後我累到幾乎撐不開眼睛。

example.en: A foreigner asked me for directions to the train station yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天有位外國人向我問路，要去火車站。

example.en: Please put the leftover soup in the refrigerator before it goes bad.
example.zh: 剩下的湯請先放進冰箱，以免壞掉。

example.en: Playing games for too long can do harm to your eyes.
example.zh: 玩遊戲玩太久可能會傷害眼睛。

example.en: The company issued a statement to apologize for the mistake.
example.zh: 公司發表聲明為這次錯誤道歉。

example.en: I have no doubt that she will pass the English test.
example.zh: 我毫不懷疑她會通過英文考試。

example.en: The atmosphere in the restaurant was warm and relaxing.
example.zh: 這家餐廳的氣氛溫馨又放鬆。

example.en: This bottle of juice contains no sugar at all.
example.zh: 這瓶果汁完全不含糖。

example.en: My English teacher is very strict about homework deadlines.
example.zh: 我的英文老師對作業截止期限非常嚴格。

example.en: The weather gradually became warmer as spring arrived.
example.zh: 春天來臨時，天氣逐漸變暖。

example.en: I am really grateful for your help with my move last weekend.
example.zh: 很感謝你上週末幫我搬家。

example.en: My grandfather helped invent a new kind of water pump.
example.zh: 我爺爺曾幫忙發明一種新型抽水機。

example.en: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan, and it is very busy.
example.zh: 台北是台灣的首都，非常熱鬧。

example.en: She sent an urgent message asking me to call her back.
example.zh: 她傳了緊急訊息，要我回電給她。

example.en: Living far from the city is a real disadvantage for my daily commute.
example.zh: 住得離市區遠，對我每天通勤是一大不利。

example.en: We bought a large quantity of rice before the typhoon season.
example.zh: 颱風季來臨前，我們買了大量的米。

example.en: I have absolute confidence that you will pass the exam.
example.zh: 我完全相信你一定考得過。

example.en: The small shop made a profit of only a few hundred dollars this month.
example.zh: 這家小店這個月只賺了幾百塊的利潤。

example.en: The new library is a welcome addition to our neighborhood.
example.zh: 新圖書館是我們社區受歡迎的新增設施。

example.en: Being chosen as class leader was a great honor for him.
example.zh: 被選為班長對他來說是很大的榮譽。

example.en: Many people now read newspapers on digital devices like tablets.
example.zh: 現在很多人用平板等數位裝置看報紙。

example.en: You need a valid license to drive any motor vehicle here.
example.zh: 在這裡開任何機動車輛都需要有效駕照。

example.en: She has a real talent for drawing and painting.
example.zh: 她很有畫畫的天分。

example.en: He decided to quit his job and start his own bakery.
example.zh: 他決定辭掉工作，自己開麵包店。

example.en: Parents should educate their children about road safety early.
example.zh: 父母應該及早教導孩子交通安全知識。

example.en: The school held a debate on whether homework should be banned.
example.zh: 學校舉辦了一場關於是否禁止回家作業的辯論。

example.en: The mayor launched a campaign to clean up the river.
example.zh: 市長發起了一項清理河川的宣導活動。

example.en: Taiwan must import most of its energy from abroad.
example.zh: 台灣大部分能源都必須仰賴進口。

example.en: The police will arrest anyone who breaks the law here.
example.zh: 警方會逮捕在這裡違法的任何人。

example.en: There is a high demand for bubble tea in summer.
example.zh: 夏天對珍珠奶茶的需求很高。

example.en: Every resident in this apartment building must sign the notice.
example.zh: 這棟大樓的每位住戶都必須在通知上簽名。

example.en: Please hang your wet umbrella near the door to dry.
example.zh: 請把濕雨傘掛在門邊晾乾。

example.en: Please separate the recyclable paper from the kitchen waste.
example.zh: 請把可回收紙類和廚餘分開。

example.en: This quiet café is suitable for studying in the afternoon.
example.zh: 這家安靜的咖啡廳適合下午讀書。

example.en: He paid off his debt after working two years abroad.
example.zh: 他在國外工作兩年後還清了債務。

example.en: Wearing a suit is appropriate for a job interview.
example.zh: 面試時穿西裝是適當的。

example.en: Have you read the latest news about the storm?
example.zh: 你看過關於暴風雨的最新消息了嗎？

example.en: The political debate on TV got very heated last night.
example.zh: 電視上的政治辯論昨晚變得非常激烈。

example.en: Many people voted in the local election last Sunday.
example.zh: 上週日很多人投票參加地方選舉。

example.en: Please select one dessert from the menu before ordering.
example.zh: 點餐前請從菜單中挑選一種甜點。

example.en: We spent a peaceful afternoon reading by the lake.
example.zh: 我們在湖邊看書，度過一個寧靜的下午。

example.en: I bought a dozen eggs at the market this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上在市場買了一打雞蛋。

example.en: Wearing wide-leg pants is a popular trend this year.
example.zh: 今年穿寬褲是很流行的趨勢。

example.en: My senior colleague always helps me with difficult projects.
example.zh: 我的資深同事總是在困難的專案上幫我。

example.en: His long speech began to bore everyone in the room.
example.zh: 他冗長的演講開始讓房裡每個人都覺得無聊。

example.en: She wore casual clothes to the weekend picnic.
example.zh: 她週末野餐時穿著輕鬆的便服。

example.en: The wedding invitation asked guests to wear formal dress.
example.zh: 喜帖要求賓客穿正式的禮服。

example.en: Please greet your grandparents when they visit us.
example.zh: 他們來拜訪時，請向你的祖父母打招呼。

example.en: The unclear map might confuse drivers who are new here.
example.zh: 不清楚的地圖可能會讓剛來這裡的駕駛感到困惑。

example.en: My aim is to finish this course before summer.
example.zh: 我的目標是在夏天前修完這門課。

example.en: Dogs may attack strangers if they feel threatened.
example.zh: 狗如果覺得受威脅，可能會攻擊陌生人。

example.en: The chief engineer will explain the new plan today.
example.zh: 總工程師今天會說明新計畫。

example.en: Please read the second section of the report carefully.
example.zh: 請仔細閱讀報告的第二部分。

example.en: This small device can charge your phone very quickly.
example.zh: 這個小裝置可以很快幫手機充電。

example.en: The kids felt scared when the lights suddenly went out.
example.zh: 燈突然熄滅時，孩子們感到害怕。

example.en: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to the child.
example.zh: 護士用溫柔的聲音跟小孩說話。

example.en: Please keep your luggage with you at all times.
example.zh: 請隨時把行李放在身邊。

example.en: I need to transfer money to my sister's account.
example.zh: 我需要把錢轉到姊姊的帳戶。

example.en: The shiny object on the floor caught my eye.
example.zh: 地上那個閃亮的物體吸引了我的目光。

example.en: It was not my fault that the meeting got canceled.
example.zh: 會議被取消不是我的錯。

example.en: She sent me an invitation to her birthday party.
example.zh: 她寄給我一張生日派對的邀請函。

example.en: Parking in this area is illegal after nine o'clock.
example.zh: 九點過後在這個區域停車是違法的。

example.en: She greeted every customer with a friendly manner.
example.zh: 她用友善的態度招呼每位顧客。

example.en: The new management team plans to improve customer service this year.
example.zh: 新的管理團隊打算今年改善客服品質。

example.en: We waited at the airport gate for the arrival of our friend.
example.zh: 我們在機場登機門等朋友抵達。

example.en: A small backpack is more practical for daily commuting than a large suitcase.
example.zh: 對每天通勤來說，小背包比大行李箱更實用。

example.en: Earth is the only planet we know that has life.
example.zh: 地球是我們所知唯一有生命的行星。

example.en: His loud singing at the party embarrassed him in front of everyone.
example.zh: 他在派對上大聲唱歌，當眾讓他很尷尬。

example.en: Could you give me a specific date for the meeting?
example.zh: 你能告訴我會議的具體日期嗎？

example.en: Is it legal to sell homemade food in this city?
example.zh: 在這個城市賣自製食品合法嗎？

example.en: The little boy grabbed his mother's hand when the dog barked.
example.zh: 小男孩一聽到狗叫，就抓住媽媽的手。

example.en: Please read the instructions carefully before you assemble the shelf.
example.zh: 組裝書架前請仔細閱讀說明。

example.en: She works the night shift at the hospital every weekend.
example.zh: 她每個週末在醫院值大夜班。

example.en: My teacher asked me to edit the essay before Friday.
example.zh: 老師要我在週五前修改這篇作文。

example.en: Karaoke is a popular form of entertainment for young people in Taiwan.
example.zh: 卡拉OK是台灣年輕人很受歡迎的娛樂。

example.en: The bus is the most direct way to get from here to the station.
example.zh: 搭公車是從這裡到車站最直接的方式。

example.en: Please check the label on the bottle before you drink it.
example.zh: 喝之前請先看看瓶子上的標籤。

example.en: The museum will display ancient pottery from the Han dynasty next month.
example.zh: 博物館下個月將展示漢代的古代陶器。

example.en: We drove along the coast and watched the sunset over the ocean.
example.zh: 我們沿著海岸開車，看著海上的夕陽。

example.en: I finished reading a mystery novel during my long flight.
example.zh: 長途飛行時，我看完了一本推理小說。

example.en: Summer in Taipei is hot and humid, so I always carry a fan.
example.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕，所以我總是隨身帶把扇子。

example.en: Good leadership helps a team stay focused during difficult times.
example.zh: 好的領導能幫助團隊在困難時保持專注。

example.en: I bought this jacket at the night market for a real bargain.
example.zh: 我在夜市買這件外套，真是撿到便宜。

example.en: The two brothers had a conflict over who should clean the kitchen.
example.zh: 兩兄弟因為誰該打掃廚房而起了衝突。

example.en: After years of hard work, she truly deserves this promotion.
example.zh: 經過多年努力，她真的值得這次升遷。

example.en: This restaurant offers a wide variety of vegetarian dishes.
example.zh: 這家餐廳提供種類繁多的素食料理。

example.en: I dislike waking up early on rainy mornings.
example.zh: 我不喜歡在下雨的早上早起。

example.en: She hugged her soft pillow before falling asleep.
example.zh: 她睡著前抱著柔軟的枕頭。

example.en: The sudden rain caught everyone without umbrellas at the bus stop.
example.zh: 那場突如其來的雨讓公車站的人都沒帶傘。

example.en: The storm knocked out electricity in our neighborhood last night.
example.zh: 昨晚暴風雨讓我們社區停電了。

example.en: My grandfather coughs every morning so we worry about him.
example.zh: 我爺爺每天早上都咳嗽，我們很擔心他。

example.en: Our team became the champion after winning the final game.
example.zh: 我們隊伍贏得決賽後成為冠軍。

example.en: Smoking is harmful to your health so please quit early.
example.zh: 抽菸對健康有害，所以請及早戒菸。

example.en: She booked a domestic flight to Kaohsiung for next weekend.
example.zh: 她預訂了下週末飛往高雄的國內班機。

example.en: His magic tricks always amaze the children at the party.
example.zh: 他的魔術總是讓派對上的孩子們驚嘆。

example.en: Choosing the right college is a significant decision for every student.
example.zh: 選擇適合的大學是每位學生的重要決定。

example.en: The street is full of commercial shops selling snacks and souvenirs.
example.zh: 這條街上滿是販售零食和紀念品的商業店家。

example.en: This website has a helpful link to the tour schedule.
example.zh: 這個網站有一個通往旅遊行程表的連結。

example.en: The two armies fought a long battle near the river.
example.zh: 兩支軍隊在河邊進行了一場漫長的戰役。

example.en: Please read the passage and answer the questions below.
example.zh: 請閱讀這段文章，並回答下面的問題。

example.en: I bought a fashion magazine at the train station this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上在火車站買了一本時尚雜誌。

example.en: The whole team celebrated their victory with a big dinner.
example.zh: 全隊為了慶祝勝利，舉辦了一場豐盛的晚餐。

example.en: Please bring a warm blanket because the bus gets very cold.
example.zh: 請帶條溫暖的毯子，因為巴士裡會很冷。

example.en: Today's lecture on climate change was very interesting and useful.
example.zh: 今天關於氣候變遷的課程很有趣也很實用。

example.en: Many people value the freedom to choose their own careers.
example.zh: 許多人重視自己選擇職業的自由。

example.en: The company faced a serious financial crisis during the economic downturn.
example.zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間面臨嚴重的財務危機。

example.en: My sister changed her lifestyle and now exercises every morning.
example.zh: 我姊姊改變了生活方式，現在每天早上都運動。

example.en: The host welcomed every guest with a warm smile at the door.
example.zh: 主人在門口帶著溫暖的笑容歡迎每位客人。

example.en: The actual cost of the trip was lower than we had expected.
example.zh: 這趟旅行的實際花費比我們預期的低。

example.en: Please refer to the manual if the machine stops working.
example.zh: 如果機器停止運作，請參考說明書。

example.en: Her belief in hard work helped her succeed in her career.
example.zh: 她對努力工作的信念幫助她在事業上成功。

example.en: The elderly man sat on the bench every morning to feed pigeons.
example.zh: 那位年長的男士每天早上都坐在長椅上餵鴿子。

example.en: The traffic light turned red, which is a signal to stop.
example.zh: 交通號誌轉紅燈，這是停車的信號。

example.en: People tend to forget names when they meet many new faces.
example.zh: 人們遇到很多新面孔時，往往會忘記名字。

example.en: Please turn down the music so you don't disturb the neighbors.
example.zh: 請把音樂關小聲一點，別打擾鄰居。

example.en: The little boy pretended to be a pirate during the game.
example.zh: 小男孩在遊戲中假裝自己是海盜。

example.en: To my relief, the test results were better than I expected.
example.zh: 讓我鬆了一口氣的是，考試成績比我預期的好。

example.en: Every citizen should vote in the local election to make a difference.
example.zh: 每位公民都應該投票參加地方選舉，才能帶來改變。

example.en: We followed the animal's tracks through the snow until dark.
example.zh: 我們循著動物在雪地上的足跡走，直到天黑。

example.en: Don't judge a book by its cover because people can surprise you.
example.zh: 不要以貌取人，因為人們可能會讓你驚訝。

example.en: It is rare to see snow in this city during summer.
example.zh: 這座城市在夏天很少見到下雪。

example.en: The store assistant helped me find the right size shoes.
example.zh: 店員幫我找到合適尺寸的鞋子。

example.en: After months of waiting, the couple decided to adopt a puppy from the shelter.
example.zh: 等了好幾個月後，這對夫妻決定從收容所收養一隻小狗。

example.en: She has watched the whole series of that detective show twice.
example.zh: 那部偵探影集她整季已經看過兩次了。

example.en: My brother doesn't like raw fish, so he ordered grilled salmon.
example.zh: 我弟弟不喜歡生魚，所以他點了烤鮭魚。

example.en: The doctor said the treatment would take about two weeks to work.
example.zh: 醫生說這個療程大約需要兩週才會見效。

example.en: Many parents worry about violence in video games and movies.
example.zh: 許多父母擔心電玩和電影裡的暴力內容。

example.en: The school will announce the winners of the contest on Friday.
example.zh: 學校將在星期五公布比賽的得獎者。

example.en: The company saw rapid growth in sales after launching the new app.
example.zh: 公司推出新應用程式後，銷售額快速成長。

example.en: The powerful earthquake shook the whole city for almost a minute.
example.zh: 那場強烈的地震讓整座城市搖晃了將近一分鐘。

example.en: The dress has a beautiful flower pattern printed on the fabric.
example.zh: 這件洋裝的布料上印有漂亮的花朵圖案。

example.en: Music can bring out strong emotions in people like joy or sadness.
example.zh: 音樂能引發人們強烈的情感，例如喜悅或悲傷。

example.en: The majority of students in our class walk to school every day.
example.zh: 我們班上大多數學生每天都走路上學。

example.en: His reaction to the bad news surprised everyone in the room.
example.zh: 他對壞消息的反應讓房裡的每個人都很驚訝。

example.en: Walking on my sprained ankle was very painful this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上用扭傷的腳踝走路非常痛。

example.en: I always bring my laptop to the café so I can finish my report.
example.zh: 我總是把筆記型電腦帶到咖啡廳，這樣才能完成報告。

example.en: Her room is always neat, with every book on the shelf.
example.zh: 她的房間總是很整潔，每本書都放在書架上。

example.en: My sister tried to persuade me to join her yoga class.
example.zh: 我姊姊想說服我一起去上瑜伽課。

example.en: Students get free access to the library computers after school.
example.zh: 學生放學後可以免費使用圖書館的電腦。

example.en: The female teacher at my school teaches English and music.
example.zh: 我們學校那位女老師教英文和音樂。

example.en: Every individual in the class has a unique way of learning.
example.zh: 班上每個人學習的方式都很獨特。

example.en: Some passengers became impatient when the train was delayed again.
example.zh: 火車又延誤，有些乘客開始不耐煩了。

example.en: Regular exercise can improve your mental health and mood.
example.zh: 規律運動可以改善你的心理健康和情緒。

example.en: You need a valid driver's license to rent this car.
example.zh: 你必須有有效的駕照才能租這輛車。

example.en: All children deserve equal chances to learn and grow.
example.zh: 所有孩子都應該有平等的學習與成長機會。

example.en: My grandparents live in a quiet district near the river.
example.zh: 我的祖父母住在河邊一個安靜的地區。

example.en: Keep all cleaning products out of reach since they can contain poison.
example.zh: 清潔用品要放在孩子拿不到的地方，因為可能含有毒物。

example.en: The old man is blind but he still walks his dog every morning.
example.zh: 那位老先生眼睛看不見，但每天早上仍會遛狗。

example.en: She bought an electronic dictionary because it is lighter than books.
example.zh: 她買了一台電子辭典，因為比書輕便。

example.en: The magician showed us a trick that made a coin disappear.
example.zh: 魔術師表演了一個讓硬幣消失的把戲。

example.en: He has a real passion for cooking and tries new recipes every week.
example.zh: 他非常熱愛烹飪，每週都會嘗試新食譜。

example.en: Take a deep breath before you walk onto the stage.
example.zh: 上台前先深呼吸一下。

example.en: The teacher praised the students for their hard work on the project.
example.zh: 老師稱讚學生在這個專題上的努力。

example.en: This region is famous for its fresh seafood and mountain views.
example.zh: 這個地區以新鮮海鮮和山景聞名。

example.en: I downloaded the newest version of the app last night.
example.zh: 我昨晚下載了這個應用程式的最新版本。

example.en: The restaurant keeps a high standard of cleanliness in the kitchen.
example.zh: 這家餐廳廚房的清潔維持在很高的標準。

example.en: Only a few plants can survive in the desert without much water.
example.zh: 沙漠裡只有少數植物能在缺水的環境下存活。

example.en: Her absence from class was noticed because she never misses lessons.
example.zh: 她很少缺課，所以大家都注意到她這次沒來上課。

example.en: The park does not permit visitors to bring dogs inside.
example.zh: 公園不允許遊客帶狗進入。

example.en: My best friend has a cheerful personality that makes everyone smile.
example.zh: 我最好的朋友個性開朗，總是讓大家笑。

example.en: She won an award for the best short film at the festival.
example.zh: 她的短片在影展中贏得最佳短片獎。

example.en: The movie really disappointed me because the ending was so weak.
example.zh: 那部電影的結局很差，讓我非常失望。

example.en: The construction of the new subway station will take two years.
example.zh: 新地鐵站的建造要花兩年時間。

example.en: Please write a short description of your favorite place.
example.zh: 請寫一段你最喜歡的地方的簡短描述。

example.en: My neighbors are very noisy, so I cannot sleep at night.
example.zh: 我的鄰居很吵，晚上我無法睡覺。

example.en: Each red star on the flag represents one state of the country.
example.zh: 旗子上每顆紅星都代表國家的一個州。

example.en: My boss is flexible, so I can choose my working hours.
example.zh: 我的老闆很有彈性，我可以自己選擇上班時間。

example.en: Could you wrap this gift in red paper, please?
example.zh: 可以幫我用紅色紙把這份禮物包起來嗎？

example.en: The length of this bridge is about two kilometers.
example.zh: 這座橋的長度大約是兩公里。

example.en: Children rely on their parents for food and care.
example.zh: 孩子仰賴父母提供食物和照顧。

example.en: Many people pray before they eat dinner together.
example.zh: 很多人在一起吃晚餐前會先禱告。

example.en: My doctor advised me to drink more water every day.
example.zh: 醫生建議我每天多喝水。

example.en: We crossed the border into Canada early in the morning.
example.zh: 我們一大早就越過邊界進入加拿大。

example.en: My grandmother is very generous and always shares her food with others.
example.zh: 我的祖母非常慷慨，總是和別人分享食物。

example.en: She hesitated for a moment before answering the difficult question.
example.zh: 她回答這個難題前猶豫了一下。

example.en: This area is a no-parking zone, so please park somewhere else.
example.zh: 這一帶是禁止停車區，請停到別處。

example.en: She felt depressed after losing her job last month.
example.zh: 她上個月失去工作後非常沮喪。

example.en: The security guard checked our tickets at the front gate.
example.zh: 保全人員在大門口檢查我們的票。

example.en: Let's divide the pizza into eight equal slices.
example.zh: 我們把披薩切成八等份吧。

example.en: Scientists observe the birds carefully to learn their habits.
example.zh: 科學家仔細觀察這些鳥，以了解牠們的習性。

example.en: Farmers do hard labor in the fields from dawn to dusk.
example.zh: 農夫從日出到日落都在田裡辛苦勞動。

example.en: The table is stable, so it will not fall over.
example.zh: 這張桌子很穩，不會倒下來。

example.en: We signed an agreement that lets us use the office for free.
example.zh: 我們簽了一份協議，可以免費使用這間辦公室。

example.en: My grandfather is still alive and lives in a small village.
example.zh: 我的祖父還健在，住在一個小村莊裡。

example.en: I tried three restaurants, but none of them were open today.
example.zh: 我試了三家餐廳，但今天都沒有營業。

example.en: Every consumer has the right to return a broken product.
example.zh: 每位消費者都有權退還損壞的商品。

example.en: The original plan was to visit Taipei first, but we changed it.
example.zh: 原本的計畫是先去台北，但我們後來改了。

example.en: The scenery along the coast road is beautiful in the spring.
example.zh: 春天時沿海公路的風景非常美。

example.en: You need to register online before you can join the course.
example.zh: 你必須先在網路上註冊，才能參加這門課程。

example.en: She spent the entire weekend cleaning the apartment.
example.zh: 她整個週末都在打掃公寓。

example.en: Families gather at the temple to celebrate the festival together.
example.zh: 家人們聚集在廟裡一起慶祝節日。

example.en: Heavy rain may threaten the crops in the southern farms.
example.zh: 豪大雨可能會危害南部農場的作物。

example.en: A volunteer will assist the elderly in filling out the forms.
example.zh: 一位志工會協助老人填寫表格。

example.en: My classmates organized a surprise party for our teacher.
example.zh: 我的同學們為我們的老師籌辦了一場驚喜派對。

example.en: You have to pay a deposit before you rent the apartment.
example.zh: 你租公寓之前必須先付押金。

zh: 使印象深刻；給人留下深刻印象

example.en: His speech at the meeting really impressed the managers.
example.zh: 他在會議上的演講真的讓經理們印象深刻。

example.en: Grandma keeps her precious photos in an old wooden box.
example.zh: 奶奶把她珍貴的照片放在一個舊木盒裡。

example.en: The city has changed a lot over the past decade.
example.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間改變了很多。

example.en: With hard work, he finally overcame his fear of swimming.
example.zh: 經過努力，他終於克服了對游泳的恐懼。

example.en: The fog disappeared quickly after the sun came out.
example.zh: 太陽出來後，霧很快就消失了。

example.en: Her courage in the race inspired many young athletes.
example.zh: 她在比賽中的勇氣激勵了許多年輕運動員。

example.en: The firefighters rescued a cat stuck on the roof.
example.zh: 消防隊員救下了一隻卡在屋頂上的貓。

example.en: Please inform the front desk if you will be late.
example.zh: 如果你會晚到，請通知櫃檯。

example.en: Weather experts predict that it will be sunny tomorrow.
example.zh: 氣象專家預測明天會是晴天。

example.en: It was raining heavily, therefore we canceled the picnic.
example.zh: 雨下得很大，因此我們取消了野餐。

example.en: The strong typhoon destroyed several old houses near the river.
example.zh: 強烈颱風摧毀了河邊幾棟老房子。

example.en: Our train leaves from platform five in ten minutes.
example.zh: 我們的火車十分鐘後從五號月台出發。

example.en: I hope my sister will forgive me for forgetting her birthday.
example.zh: 我希望姐姐能原諒我忘記她的生日。

example.en: The plane flew at a height of ten thousand meters.
example.zh: 飛機以一萬公尺的高度飛行。

example.en: My brothers and I share the housework every weekend.
example.zh: 我和兄弟們每個週末一起分擔家務。

example.en: There is a wide gap between the rich and the poor in the city.
example.zh: 這座城市的貧富之間有很大的差距。

example.en: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
example.zh: 我們上週為客廳買了新家具。

example.en: The school set up a fund to help students buy books.
example.zh: 學校設立了一筆基金，幫助學生購買書籍。

example.en: The economic situation in our town has improved this year.
example.zh: 今年我們鎮上的經濟狀況有所改善。

example.en: Many farmers suffer when there is no rain for months.
example.zh: 好幾個月沒下雨時，許多農夫都會受苦。

example.en: I forgot my umbrella, but fortunately it did not rain.
example.zh: 我忘了帶雨傘，幸好沒有下雨。

example.en: Rising water levels are a serious threat to the coastal village.
example.zh: 水位上升對沿海村莊是嚴重的威脅。

example.en: My grandmother uses a mobile phone to call her friends.
example.zh: 我祖母用行動電話打電話給朋友。

example.en: I feel sick because my stomach hurts after lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後肚子痛，我覺得不舒服。

example.en: The author of this novel is a famous woman from Taiwan.
example.zh: 這本小說的作者是一位來自台灣的知名女性。

example.en: Please knock before entering, because I value my privacy.
example.zh: 進來前請先敲門，因為我很重視自己的隱私。

example.en: The students will elect a new class president next month.
example.zh: 學生下個月會選出新的班長。

example.en: You need an official document to open a bank account here.
example.zh: 在這裡開戶需要正式的證件文件。

example.en: Please keep a spare key in case you lose the first one.
example.zh: 請備一把備用鑰匙，以防你弄丟第一把。

example.en: She wrote a short poem about her love for the ocean.
example.zh: 她寫了一首短詩，描述她對大海的喜愛。

example.en: I really admire my sister because she works so hard.
example.zh: 我非常欽佩我姐姐，因為她工作很努力。

example.en: My father bought an electric scooter to ride to work.
example.zh: 我父親買了一台電動機車騎去上班。

example.en: The store can guarantee that the laptop will work for two years.
example.zh: 這家店可以保證這台筆電能用兩年。

example.en: Please keep the receipt in case you want to return the shirt.
example.zh: 請保留收據，以防你想退這件襯衫。

example.en: Let's switch to the other lane because the traffic is slow here.
example.zh: 這裡車流很慢，我們換到另一條車道吧。

example.en: The doctor said the operation on my father's knee went well.
example.zh: 醫生說我父親膝蓋的手術很順利。

example.en: Climate change is a global problem that affects every country.
example.zh: 氣候變遷是影響每個國家的全球性問題。

example.en: I need to do the laundry before my trip this weekend.
example.zh: 這週末旅行前，我得先把衣服洗一洗。

example.en: Nowadays, many people pay for food with their phones.
example.zh: 現今，很多人用手機付餐費。

example.en: The teacher will determine the winner after reading all the essays.
example.zh: 老師讀完所有作文後，會決定優勝者。

example.en: You must show your identity card before you can enter the building.
example.zh: 進入大樓前，你必須出示身分證。

example.en: Rent is my biggest monthly expense in the city.
example.zh: 房租是我在這座城市每月最大的開銷。

example.en: She was in a good mood after her morning coffee.
example.zh: 喝完早上的咖啡後，她心情很好。

example.en: You can order whatever you like from the menu tonight.
example.zh: 今晚你可以從菜單上點任何你喜歡的東西。

example.en: My grandfather seldom uses his phone, preferring letters instead.
example.zh: 我爺爺很少用手機，他比較喜歡寫信。

example.en: My uncle is an expert in fixing old cars.
example.zh: 我叔叔是修理老舊汽車的專家。

example.en: The instructions for assembling this shelf are really complicated.
example.zh: 組裝這個書架的說明真的很複雜。

example.en: Which category does this product belong to on the website?
example.zh: 這項商品在網站上屬於哪一個類別？

example.en: Everyone in our class will participate in the school sports day.
example.zh: 我們班上每個人都會參加學校的運動會。

example.en: I assumed the meeting started at ten, but it was at nine.
example.zh: 我以為會議十點開始，結果是九點。

example.en: The travel agent found us a cheap flight to Japan.
example.zh: 旅行社的代理人幫我們找到去日本的便宜機票。

example.en: Teaching young children requires a lot of patience.
example.zh: 教小孩子需要很大的耐心。

example.en: Bright colors are back in fashion this spring.
example.zh: 今年春天鮮豔的顏色又流行了。

example.en: There is a famous coffee chain on every corner here.
example.zh: 這裡每個街角都有一家知名的連鎖咖啡店。

example.en: The store's supply of fresh bread runs out by noon.
example.zh: 這家店的新鮮麵包供應到中午就賣完了。

example.en: Please attach your résumé to the email before sending it.
example.zh: 寄出前請把履歷附在電子郵件裡。

example.en: My parents plan to retire to the countryside next year.
example.zh: 我父母明年打算退休後搬到鄉下。

example.en: Neither of my brothers likes spicy food at all.
example.zh: 我的兩個哥哥都不喜歡辣的食物。

example.en: Let's wear our best clothes for this special occasion.
example.zh: 這麼特別的場合，我們穿最好的衣服吧。

example.en: She has a background in marketing so she got the job.
example.zh: 她有行銷背景，所以拿到了這份工作。

example.en: On weekends we like to explore new cafes around town.
example.zh: 週末我們喜歡去探索城裡新開的咖啡館。

example.en: My little sister felt jealous when I got a new bike.
example.zh: 我買了新腳踏車，妹妹就覺得很嫉妒。

example.en: My skin is very sensitive so I use only gentle soap.
example.zh: 我的皮膚很敏感，所以只用溫和的肥皂。

example.en: A typical day for me starts with coffee and emails.
example.zh: 我平常的一天通常從喝咖啡和看信開始。

example.en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
example.zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

example.en: The train journey from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes about two hours.
example.zh: 從台北搭火車到高雄的旅程大約要兩小時。

example.en: Their marriage has lasted for over thirty years.
example.zh: 他們的婚姻已經維持三十多年了。

example.en: She is just an ordinary student who loves reading books.
example.zh: 她只是一個喜歡看書的普通學生。

example.en: The best feature of this phone is its long battery life.
example.zh: 這支手機最棒的特色是電池續航力很長。

example.en: Working two jobs at the same time is really tough.
example.zh: 同時做兩份工作真的很辛苦。

example.en: The price of rice has stayed steady for months.
example.zh: 米價好幾個月來都維持穩定。

example.en: After graduation, she decided to settle in Taichung.
example.zh: 畢業後，她決定定居在台中。

example.en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk along the river this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上沿著河邊散步，過得很愉快。

example.en: The photographer took beautiful pictures of the wedding.
example.zh: 那位攝影師為這場婚禮拍了很美的照片。

example.en: The company rejected my job application because I lacked experience.
example.zh: 公司因為我缺乏經驗而拒絕了我的求職申請。

example.en: A strong earthquake shook the city early this morning.
example.zh: 今天清晨一場強烈地震撼動了這座城市。

example.en: Can you help me calculate the total cost of the trip?
example.zh: 你可以幫我算一下這趟旅行的總花費嗎？

example.en: We watched a funny film about a family trip last night.
example.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部關於家庭旅行的好笑電影。

example.en: The night market sells various kinds of snacks and drinks.
example.zh: 夜市賣各式各樣的小吃和飲料。

example.en: My grandmother often tells stories about her childhood in the countryside.
example.zh: 我奶奶常說起她在鄉下的童年故事。

example.en: Please breathe slowly and try to relax your shoulders.
example.zh: 請慢慢呼吸，試著放鬆肩膀。

example.en: My brother is studying overseas in Japan this year.
example.zh: 我哥哥今年在海外留學，去了日本。

example.en: The manager gave a brief speech before the meeting started.
example.zh: 經理在會議開始前發表了簡短的演說。

example.en: The customer made a complaint about the slow service.
example.zh: 那位顧客投訴服務太慢。

example.en: Combine the eggs and flour in a large bowl and stir well.
example.zh: 把雞蛋和麵粉放進大碗裡混合，攪拌均勻。

example.en: It is a pleasure to meet you, Ms. Lin.
example.zh: 很高興認識你，林小姐。

example.en: A volunteer helped the elderly carry groceries up the stairs.
example.zh: 一位志工幫忙老人家把雜貨搬上樓梯。

example.en: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees before baking the cookies.
example.zh: 烤餅乾之前，先把烤箱預熱到一百八十度。

example.en: The store sells household goods at very reasonable prices.
example.zh: 這家店以很合理的價格販售日用商品。

example.en: I bought a larger monitor so I can work more comfortably.
example.zh: 我買了一台較大的螢幕，工作時比較舒服。

example.en: Write your name in the blank box at the top of the form.
example.zh: 請在表格上方的空白方格裡寫下你的名字。

example.en: She prefers a plain white shirt for work.
example.zh: 她上班喜歡穿樸素的白襯衫。

example.en: My grandmother gave me her favorite recipe for apple pie.
example.zh: 奶奶把她最愛的蘋果派食譜給了我。

example.en: I got the impression that he was not happy with the plan.
example.zh: 我覺得他對這個計畫不太滿意。

example.en: There was a slight change in the weather this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上天氣有些微的變化。

example.en: Please bring your umbrella, otherwise you will get wet.
example.zh: 請帶把傘，否則你會淋濕。

example.en: We drove along the highway for three hours to reach the beach.
example.zh: 我們沿著公路開了三個小時才到海邊。

example.en: I regret not studying harder for the final exam.
example.zh: 我很後悔期末考前沒有更用功讀書。

example.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the vote.
example.zh: 每位候選人在投票前都發表了簡短演說。

example.en: My cousin is a lawyer who helps families with property issues.
example.zh: 我表哥是一位律師，專門幫家庭處理財產問題。

example.en: They built a small cabin in a remote village in the mountains.
example.zh: 他們在山上一個偏遠的村落蓋了一間小木屋。

example.en: Tom was absent from class today because he had a fever.
example.zh: 湯姆今天因為發燒而沒來上課。

example.en: The library is a great resource for students who are writing research papers.
example.zh: 圖書館對寫研究報告的學生來說是很好的資源。

example.en: It took me a while to understand the concept of supply and demand.
example.zh: 我花了一段時間才理解供需的概念。

example.en: The doctor will examine your arm to see if it is broken.
example.zh: 醫生會檢查你的手臂，看看有沒有骨折。

example.en: We bought car insurance in case of an accident.
example.zh: 我們買了汽車保險以防萬一發生事故。

example.en: My brother works as an engineer for a company that builds bridges.
example.zh: 我哥哥在一家蓋橋樑的公司擔任工程師。

example.en: The two friends had an argument about who should pay for dinner.
example.zh: 兩個朋友為了誰該付晚餐錢而吵了一架。

example.en: He took out a loan to buy his first apartment.
example.zh: 他貸款買了人生的第一間公寓。

example.en: It was obvious that she was tired after the long trip.
example.zh: 長途旅行後，她明顯很累。

example.en: My employer allows us to work from home on Fridays.
example.zh: 我的雇主允許我們星期五在家工作。

example.en: She entered a cooking contest and won first prize.
example.zh: 她參加廚藝比賽並拿到第一名。

example.en: Don't worry, there is plenty of food for everyone.
example.zh: 別擔心，食物很多，每個人都吃得到。

example.en: My mom will insist that I wear a helmet when I ride my bike.
example.zh: 我媽媽會堅持我騎腳踏車時要戴安全帽。

example.en: The teacher showed us a new technique for solving math problems.
example.zh: 老師教我們一種解數學題的新技巧。

example.en: His first attempt to fix the bike failed, so he tried again.
example.zh: 他第一次修腳踏車失敗了，於是再試一次。

example.en: The company will release the new app next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月會發布這款新應用程式。

example.en: The vacation was nice, but the reality of paying the bills came back quickly.
example.zh: 假期很愉快，但付帳單的現實很快就回來了。

example.en: The grocery store gave us a free sample of cheese.
example.zh: 超市免費給我們一小塊起司試吃。

example.en: My phone battery is almost dead, so I need a charger.
example.zh: 我的手機電池快沒電了，所以需要充電器。

example.en: The number of visitors to the park began to decrease in winter.
example.zh: 冬天時，來公園的遊客人數開始減少。

example.en: My little brother struggles to tie his shoelaces by himself.
example.zh: 我弟弟自己綁鞋帶時很吃力。

example.en: The police found strong evidence that he was at the scene.
example.zh: 警方找到有力證據，證明他當時在現場。

example.en: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked all night.
example.zh: 你整晚都沒鎖門，真是太粗心了。

example.en: Please check the departure time of your flight before leaving home.
example.zh: 出門前請先確認你班機的出發時間。

example.en: Many young workers complain that their hourly wage is too low.
example.zh: 許多年輕員工抱怨時薪太低。

example.en: We meet on a weekly basis to review our progress.
example.zh: 我們每週開會一次，檢討進度。

example.en: She was upset after her best friend forgot her birthday.
example.zh: 她的好朋友忘了她的生日，她很難過。

example.en: A technician came today to install a new air conditioner in our office.
example.zh: 今天有技師來辦公室安裝新的冷氣。

example.en: This button is loose, so it might fall off soon.
example.zh: 這顆釦子鬆了，可能很快就會掉。

example.en: My daughter is curious about how airplanes can fly.
example.zh: 我女兒很好奇飛機怎麼飛得起來。

example.en: Could you arrange a meeting with the manager for Friday?
example.zh: 你可以幫我安排星期五和經理的會議嗎？

example.en: If you don't like the red shirt, there is another option in blue.
example.zh: 如果你不喜歡紅色襯衫，還有藍色的選擇。

example.en: My neighbor is a native speaker of Japanese, so she helps me with pronunciation.
example.zh: 我的鄰居母語是日文，所以她幫我練發音。

example.en: The report shows a figure of over one thousand new customers this month.
example.zh: 報告顯示這個月新增客戶超過一千人。

example.en: She works for a charity organization that helps children in need.
example.zh: 她在一個幫助貧困兒童的慈善機構工作。

example.en: I want a particular brand of coffee, not just any kind.
example.zh: 我想要某個特定品牌的咖啡，不是隨便哪一種。

example.en: The loud music from the next room really annoys me when I study.
example.zh: 我讀書時，隔壁房間的大音樂真的很煩人。

example.en: Please delete the old photos from your phone to free up space.
example.zh: 請刪除手機裡的舊照片，騰出一些空間。

example.en: That old sweater is ugly, so I will throw it away.
example.zh: 那件舊毛衣很醜，我要把它丟掉。

example.en: My suitcase weighs twenty kilograms, so it is too heavy.
example.zh: 我的行李箱重二十公斤，所以太重了。

example.en: The price is shown per unit, so one bottle costs two dollars.
example.zh: 價格是以每單位顯示的，所以一瓶兩美元。

example.en: The old map led the children to a hidden treasure in the forest.
example.zh: 那張舊地圖帶孩子們找到森林裡藏著的寶藏。

example.en: These shoes are too tight, so my feet really hurt.
example.zh: 這雙鞋太緊了，我的腳很痛。

example.en: If you have a headache, you should seek advice from a doctor.
example.zh: 如果頭痛，你應該向醫生尋求建議。

example.en: The teacher did not force the students to join the club.
example.zh: 老師並沒有強迫學生加入社團。

example.en: Because of the heavy rain, we decided to postpone the picnic.
example.zh: 因為下大雨，我們決定把野餐延期。

example.en: I found a good travel agency that helped plan our trip to Japan.
example.zh: 我找到一家不錯的旅行社，幫我們規劃日本之旅。

example.en: My uncle was worried after the doctor found cancer in his lungs.
example.zh: 醫生在我叔叔的肺部發現癌症後，他非常擔心。

example.en: My brother is reliable, so I always ask him for help.
example.zh: 我哥哥很可靠，所以我總是找他幫忙。

example.en: She sent her job application by email before the deadline.
example.zh: 她在截止日前用電子郵件寄出了工作申請。

example.en: You need permission from your parents before going on the trip.
example.zh: 去旅行前你需要得到父母的許可。

example.en: The city has seen rapid growth over the past ten years.
example.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間發展迅速。

example.en: The secretary answered the phone and scheduled the meeting.
example.zh: 秘書接了電話，並安排了會議時間。

example.en: Please whisper in the library so you do not disturb others.
example.zh: 在圖書館請小聲說話，以免打擾別人。

example.en: Her English has shown great improvement since she moved abroad.
example.zh: 自從她出國後，英文有了很大的進步。

example.en: After a month at the gym, my arm muscles felt much stronger.
example.zh: 在健身房練了一個月後，我的手臂肌肉感覺強壯多了。

example.en: The company sent a survey asking customers about their service.
example.zh: 公司寄出一份問卷，詢問顧客對服務的看法。

example.en: Can you translate this letter from Chinese into English for me?
example.zh: 你可以幫我把這封信從中文翻譯成英文嗎？

example.en: The earthquake was a terrible disaster for the small village.
example.zh: 這場地震對那個小村莊來說是一場可怕的災難。

example.en: I went to the local clinic because I had a bad cold.
example.zh: 因為感冒很嚴重，我去了附近的診所。

example.en: She felt anxious before the job interview this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上面試前，她感到很焦慮。

example.en: The heat in the afternoon was so strong that we stayed inside.
example.zh: 下午的高溫非常強烈，所以我們待在屋裡。

example.en: The news spread quickly through the whole school within an hour.
example.zh: 消息在一小時內就在全校迅速傳開了。

example.en: After graduating, he wanted to become independent from his parents.
example.zh: 畢業後，他想要在經濟和生活上脫離父母而獨立。

example.en: The charity sent food and medical aid to the flood victims.
example.zh: 這個慈善團體送去食物和醫療援助給水災災民。

example.en: The manager approved my request for a day off.
example.zh: 經理批准了我請假一天的申請。

example.en: I got a full refund because the shirt was damaged.
example.zh: 因為襯衫有損壞，我拿到了全額退款。

example.en: He fell down and scraped his knee on the sidewalk.
example.zh: 他跌倒了，膝蓋在人行道上擦傷。

example.en: A group of tall trees surrounds the small old house.
example.zh: 一排高大的樹木環繞著這棟老舊的小房子。

example.en: She hopes to gain more experience before applying for the job.
example.zh: 她希望在應徵這份工作前獲得更多經驗。

example.en: Some students cheat on tests because they are afraid of failing.
example.zh: 有些學生因為害怕不及格而在考試中作弊。

example.en: The weather forecast was accurate, so we brought umbrellas.
example.zh: 天氣預報很準確，所以我們帶了雨傘。

example.en: The little boy got a toy as a reward for cleaning his room.
example.zh: 小男孩因為打掃房間而得到一個玩具作為獎勵。

example.en: The new machine is more efficient and saves a lot of electricity.
example.zh: 這台新機器更有效率，能省下很多電。

example.en: After reading the report, I came to the conclusion that we need more staff.
example.zh: 看完報告後，我得出的結論是我們需要更多人手。

example.en: It is important to maintain a healthy diet and exercise regularly.
example.zh: 維持健康的飲食並規律運動非常重要。

example.en: This bus route goes past the train station and the hospital.
example.zh: 這條公車路線會經過火車站和醫院。

example.en: The company hired temporary workers to help during the busy holiday season.
example.zh: 公司在繁忙的假期期間聘請了臨時工來幫忙。

example.en: Her parents felt great pride when she graduated from university.
example.zh: 她大學畢業時，父母感到非常驕傲。

example.en: On weekends, he enjoys leisure activities like hiking and reading.
example.zh: 週末時，他喜歡健行和閱讀等休閒活動。

example.en: Can you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
example.zh: 你能告訴我會議的確切時間嗎？

example.en: Heavy rain caused a serious flood in the village last night.
example.zh: 昨晚的大雨在村子裡造成嚴重的水災。

example.en: I still owe my brother fifty dollars for the concert tickets.
example.zh: 我還欠哥哥五十元，是買演唱會門票的錢。

example.en: An accident occurred at the intersection this morning, blocking traffic.
example.zh: 今天早上十字路口發生了一起事故，造成交通堵塞。

example.en: My sister loves watching Korean drama series every night before bed.
example.zh: 我姊姊每晚睡前都喜歡看韓國連續劇。

example.en: I can't concentrate on my homework when the TV is on.
example.zh: 電視開著的時候，我無法專心寫功課。

example.en: The scientist explained his theory about how plants grow faster in sunlight.
example.zh: 這位科學家解釋了他關於植物在陽光下生長較快的理論。

example.en: The traffic was blocked after a car crash on the highway.
example.zh: 高速公路上發生車禍後，交通就被堵住了。

example.en: The children were eager to open their presents on Christmas morning.
example.zh: 聖誕節早上，孩子們迫不及待想打開禮物。

example.en: Please adjust the volume so that it is not too loud.
example.zh: 請把音量調整一下，不要太大聲。

example.en: The washing machine has an automatic shut-off feature.
example.zh: 這台洗衣機有自動斷電的功能。

example.en: Fresh basil is the key ingredient in this pasta sauce.
example.zh: 新鮮羅勒是這道義大利麵醬的關鍵食材。

example.en: My sister came up with a brilliant idea for our trip.
example.zh: 我姊姊為我們的旅行想到一個很棒的點子。

example.en: The gym has new exercise equipment for members.
example.zh: 這間健身房為會員添購了新的運動器材。

example.en: Let's watch the news on channel five tonight.
example.zh: 我們今晚轉到五台看新聞吧。

example.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat my ear infection.
example.zh: 醫生開抗生素來治療我的耳朵感染。

example.en: Our primary goal this month is to finish the report.
example.zh: 我們這個月的主要目標是完成報告。

example.en: Please add your signature at the bottom of the form.
example.zh: 請在表格底部簽上你的名字。

example.en: Police found a dangerous weapon hidden in the car.
example.zh: 警方在車內發現一把藏起來的危險武器。

example.en: Please behave yourself while we are at the restaurant.
example.zh: 我們在餐廳時請你乖乖的。

example.en: My neighbors are mostly quiet, except on weekends.
example.zh: 我的鄰居大多很安靜，只有週末比較吵。

example.en: The captain of our soccer team gave a short speech.
example.zh: 我們足球隊的隊長發表了簡短的演說。

example.en: Many small shops compete with big chains for customers.
example.zh: 許多小商店與大型連鎖店爭奪顧客。

example.en: The university website is a reliable source of information.
example.zh: 大學網站是可靠的資訊來源。

example.en: Our office network went down for two hours this morning.
example.zh: 我們辦公室的網路今天早上斷線了兩個小時。

example.en: The police are helping the victim of the car accident.
example.zh: 警方正在協助這起車禍的受害者。

example.en: He injured his knee while playing basketball after school.
example.zh: 他放學後打籃球時傷到了膝蓋。

example.en: My uncle has worked at a shoe factory for ten years.
example.zh: 我叔叔在一家鞋廠工作了十年。

example.en: The company claims its new phone has a longer battery life.
example.zh: 這家公司聲稱它的新手機電池更耐用。

example.en: The hotel offers an attractive price for long stays.
example.zh: 這家飯店為長住的客人提供很有吸引力的價格。

example.en: There is a possibility that it will rain this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午有可能會下雨。

example.en: The food at that restaurant tasted horrible last night.
example.zh: 昨晚那家餐廳的食物難吃極了。

example.en: Please measure the length of the table before buying a cloth.
example.zh: 買桌巾前請先量一下桌子的長度。

example.en: I have been feeling tired lately because of work.
example.zh: 因為工作的關係，我最近一直覺得很累。

example.en: Many people regard him as the best teacher in town.
example.zh: 許多人認為他是鎮上最好的老師。

example.en: She decided to invest her savings in a small business.
example.zh: 她決定把存款投資在一家小企業上。

example.en: Please respond to this email by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 請在星期五下午前回覆這封電子郵件。

example.en: My friends finally convinced me to try the new restaurant.
example.zh: 朋友們終於說服我去試試那家新餐廳。

example.en: The graduation ceremony started at ten o'clock in the morning.
example.zh: 畢業典禮早上十點開始。

example.en: He missed three games because of a knee injury.
example.zh: 他因為膝蓋受傷錯過了三場比賽。

example.en: The doctor prescribed a new drug to lower my blood pressure.
example.zh: 醫生開了一種新藥來降低我的血壓。

example.en: This old sofa gives me great comfort after a long day.
example.zh: 這張舊沙發讓我在漫長的一天後感到非常舒適。

example.en: The cat managed to escape through a small hole in the fence.
example.zh: 那隻貓設法從籬笆上的一個小洞逃了出去。

example.en: My former classmate now works as a nurse in Taipei.
example.zh: 我以前的同學現在在台北當護理師。

example.en: Children often have a wonderful imagination when they play.
example.zh: 孩子玩耍時常常有很棒的想像力。

example.en: My grandfather has a great sense of humor at family dinners.
example.zh: 我爺爺在家庭聚餐時很有幽默感。

example.en: We finished the first chapter of the novel in class today.
example.zh: 我們今天在課堂上讀完了這本小說的第一章。

example.en: The nurse took immediate action when the patient fainted.
example.zh: 病人昏倒時，護士立刻採取行動。

example.en: The waiter gave me a helpful tip about the best dishes.
example.zh: 服務生給了我一個關於最好吃菜色的實用秘訣。

example.en: Please pour some hot water into my cup, thank you.
example.zh: 麻煩幫我把一些熱水倒進杯子裡，謝謝。

example.en: I forgot to turn off the alarm, so it woke up the whole house.
example.zh: 我忘了關鬧鐘，結果吵醒了整棟房子的人。

example.en: This button has a special function for taking photos at night.
example.zh: 這個按鈕有在夜間拍照的特別功能。

example.en: Please lay the clean towels on the bed before the guests arrive.
example.zh: 客人到之前，請把乾淨的毛巾放在床上。

example.en: She stayed home from work for a week because of an illness.
example.zh: 她因為生病，在家休息了一個星期沒上班。

example.en: Our trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
example.zh: 我們去山上的旅行變成了一場真正的冒險。

example.en: My little brother is capable of cooking simple meals by himself.
example.zh: 我的弟弟能夠自己煮簡單的餐點。

example.en: Her English has a slight French accent when she speaks quickly.
example.zh: 她說快的時候，英語會帶一點法國口音。

example.en: Please keep your baggage with you at all times at the airport.
example.zh: 在機場請隨時看好你的行李。

example.en: This classic movie is still popular with young people today.
example.zh: 這部經典電影至今仍受年輕人歡迎。

example.en: The old family used their wealth to build schools in the village.
example.zh: 那個老家族用他們的財富在村子裡蓋學校。

example.en: My relative from Canada is visiting us next month.
example.zh: 我從加拿大來的親戚下個月要來拜訪我們。

example.en: He made a minor mistake on the form, but it was easy to fix.
example.zh: 他在表格上犯了一個小錯誤，但很容易修正。

example.en: Many different kinds of fish exist in this small lake.
example.zh: 這座小湖裡存在許多不同種類的魚。

example.en: We decorate the living room with balloons before the party.
example.zh: 派對前我們會用氣球佈置客廳。

example.en: Doctors have made great advances in treating heart disease.
example.zh: 醫生在治療心臟病方面有了很大的進步。

example.en: The failure of the test made him work harder next time.
example.zh: 這次考試失利，讓他下次更加努力。

example.en: After many years of saving, she eventually bought her own house.
example.zh: 經過多年存錢，她終於買下了自己的房子。

example.en: My top priority this week is finishing the English report.
example.zh: 這週我最優先的事是完成英文報告。

example.en: Please don't put your cup on the edge of the table.
example.zh: 請不要把杯子放在桌子的邊緣。

example.en: The night market is a popular tourist attraction in Taipei.
example.zh: 夜市是台北很受歡迎的觀光景點。

example.en: He didn't want to admit that he had broken the vase.
example.zh: 他不想承認是他打破了花瓶。

example.en: That factory employs over two hundred workers from the town.
example.zh: 那間工廠僱用了鎮上超過兩百名工人。

example.en: Our family goes to the beach for an annual summer trip.
example.zh: 我們家每年夏天都會去海邊旅行。

example.en: The shop advertises its new products on social media every week.
example.zh: 這家店每週都會在社群媒體上宣傳新產品。

example.en: The weather forecast says it will rain all day tomorrow.
example.zh: 天氣預報說明天會整天下雨。

example.en: Frequent rain in the south makes the rice grow well.
example.zh: 南部經常下雨，讓稻米長得很好。

example.en: My daughter got a good grade on her math test today.
example.zh: 我女兒今天數學考試拿到了好成績。

example.en: Every driver must obey the traffic rules on this road.
example.zh: 每位駕駛都必須遵守這條路上的交通規則。

example.en: Please meet me at the entrance of the train station.
example.zh: 請在火車站的入口見我。

example.en: It is your duty to take care of the dog while I am away.
example.zh: 我不在時，照顧狗是你的責任。

example.en: The red light on the machine indicates that it needs repair.
example.zh: 機器上的紅燈表示它需要修理。

example.en: Finishing a marathon was a big achievement for my father.
example.zh: 跑完馬拉松對我父親來說是一大成就。

example.en: She speaks English with confidence after studying abroad.
example.zh: 她出國留學後，說英文很有自信。

example.en: When I asked if he was ready, he just nodded with a smile.
example.zh: 我問他是否準備好了，他只是笑著點點頭。

example.en: The airline offered us a free meal because our flight was delayed.
example.zh: 因為班機延誤，航空公司提供我們免費餐點。

example.en: He goes to the gym to keep his physical health in shape.
example.zh: 他去健身房維持身體健康。

example.en: It took a lot of courage to tell the truth.
example.zh: 說出真相需要很大的勇氣。

example.en: Please clean up this mess before your mom gets home.
example.zh: 請在媽媽回家前把這團亂收拾好。

example.en: Our basketball coach gives us extra practice every Tuesday.
example.zh: 我們的籃球教練每週二都會額外加強練習。

example.en: She turned pale when she heard the bad news.
example.zh: 她聽到壞消息時臉色變得蒼白。

example.en: We followed a narrow path through the forest to the lake.
example.zh: 我們沿著森林裡的狹窄小徑走到湖邊。

example.en: Based on my previous experience, this job should be easy.
example.zh: 根據我之前的經驗，這份工作應該很簡單。

example.en: It is rude to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
example.zh: 在別人說話時打斷他們很不禮貌。

example.en: This coffee tastes bitter because I forgot to add sugar.
example.zh: 這杯咖啡很苦，因為我忘了加糖。

example.en: The chart shows how sales increased over the past three years.
example.zh: 這張圖表顯示過去三年銷售額如何成長。

example.en: A thin layer of dust covered the surface of the table.
example.zh: 一層薄薄的灰塵覆蓋了桌面。

example.en: Despite the rain, we decided to go hiking this morning.
example.zh: 儘管下雨，我們今天早上還是決定去健行。

example.en: The baby's skin feels smooth and soft after her bath.
example.zh: 洗完澡後，寶寶的皮膚摸起來光滑柔軟。

example.en: We visited ancient ruins that were built over two thousand years ago.
example.zh: 我們參觀了兩千多年前建造的古老遺跡。

example.en: Take one pill with a glass of water after every meal.
example.zh: 每餐後配一杯水吃一顆藥丸。

example.en: He felt a sharp pain in his chest and called an ambulance.
example.zh: 他覺得胸口一陣劇痛，於是叫了救護車。

example.en: Many countries are debating whether to build more nuclear power plants.
example.zh: 許多國家正在討論是否要再蓋核能發電廠。

example.en: The engineer estimates that the bridge will take two years to finish.
example.zh: 工程師估計這座橋要兩年才能完工。

example.en: She has complete faith in her friends and never doubts them.
example.zh: 她完全信任朋友，從不懷疑他們。

example.en: I still have vivid memories of our trip to the mountains.
example.zh: 我對我們去山上旅行的情景仍記得很清楚。

example.en: For no apparent reason, the boy started crying in the middle of class.
example.zh: 那男孩沒有明顯的原因，在上課中間突然哭了起來。

example.en: My grandfather always shares his wisdom when I face hard choices.
example.zh: 每當我面臨艱難抉擇時，爺爺總會分享他的智慧。

example.en: Only students who pass the exam can qualify for the scholarship.
example.zh: 只有通過考試的學生才能取得獎學金資格。

example.en: His ambition is to become a doctor and help people in need.
example.zh: 他的抱負是成為醫生，幫助有需要的人。

example.en: Even though he won the award, he remained humble and kind.
example.zh: 雖然他得了獎，仍然保持謙虛和善良。

example.en: The origin of this recipe is a small village in Italy.
example.zh: 這道食譜的起源是義大利的一個小村莊。

example.en: I prefer reading fiction over history books because the stories are exciting.
example.zh: 比起歷史書，我更喜歡看小說，因為故事比較刺激。

example.en: The company plans to expand its store network to three more cities next year.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫明年把門市網路擴展到另外三個城市。
