example.en: My grandmother likes to weave baskets from bamboo strips in the afternoon.
example.zh: 我奶奶喜歡在下午用竹篾編織籃子。

example.en: Sales of paper maps have declined sharply since smartphones became common.
example.zh: 自從智慧型手機普及後，紙本地圖的銷量大幅下滑。

example.en: The old bridge collapsed after heavy rain, so the road was closed.
example.zh: 大雨過後，那座老橋倒塌了，所以道路被封閉。

example.en: She wore a silver necklace with a small heart pendant to the party.
example.zh: 她戴著一條銀色項鍊，墜著一顆小愛心，去參加派對。

example.en: My little brother started to bleed after he fell off his bike.
example.zh: 我弟弟從腳踏車上摔下來後開始流血。

example.en: A small insect landed on my sandwich during our picnic in the park.
example.zh: 我們在公園野餐時，有一隻小昆蟲停在我的三明治上。

example.en: Taking care of two elderly parents can be a heavy burden for anyone.
example.zh: 同時照顧兩位年邁的父母，對任何人來說都可能是沉重的負擔。

example.en: The team's mission this week is to finish the report before Friday.
example.zh: 這個團隊本週的任務是在星期五前完成報告。

example.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box on the dresser.
example.zh: 她把珠寶收在梳妝台上的一個小木盒裡。

example.en: We visited an art exhibition at the museum and saw many paintings.
example.zh: 我們去博物館參觀藝術展覽，看了很多畫作。

example.en: Be careful not to spill the liquid when you pour it into the bottle.
example.zh: 把液體倒進瓶子時要小心，別灑出來。

example.en: I would never dare to climb that tall tree without a safety rope.
example.zh: 沒有安全繩，我絕不敢爬上那棵高樹。

example.en: The truck carried a heavy load of bricks to the construction site.
example.zh: 那輛卡車把一大批磚塊運到工地。

example.en: She bought a bottle of perfume with a light flower scent.
example.zh: 她買了一瓶帶有淡淡花香的香水。

example.en: Tom loves hiking in the mountains whereas his sister prefers staying at home.
example.zh: 湯姆喜歡在山裡健行，而他妹妹則偏好待在家裡。

example.en: Police arrested two men who tried to kidnap a boy from a shopping mall.
example.zh: 警方逮捕了兩名試圖從購物中心綁架男孩的男子。

example.en: Moderate exercise like a daily walk is good for your heart.
example.zh: 每天散步這類適度的運動對心臟很好。

example.en: The doctor said the scar on his arm would be permanent.
example.zh: 醫生說他手臂上的疤痕會永久留下。

example.en: Put the cups back in the cabinet above the sink, please.
example.zh: 請把杯子放回水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

example.en: My sister is pregnant and her baby is due in March.
example.zh: 我姐姐懷孕了，寶寶預產期是三月。

example.en: The tribe held a festival to celebrate the harvest season every autumn.
example.zh: 這個部落每年秋天都會舉辦慶祝豐收的節慶。

example.en: He walked at a steady pace, so we could easily keep up with him.
example.zh: 他走路步伐穩定，我們很容易就能跟上。

example.en: Our whole family will unite to help Grandma move house.
example.zh: 全家人會團結起來幫奶奶搬家。

example.en: The doctor said my son is slightly overweight, so he needs more exercise.
example.zh: 醫生說我兒子有點過重，需要多運動。

example.en: She wants to study biology at university because she loves plants.
example.zh: 她喜歡植物，想到大學主修生物學。

example.en: Thank you for your sincere apology, I really appreciate it.
example.zh: 謝謝你誠懇的道歉，我真的很感激。

example.en: We are still waiting for the outcome of the job interview.
example.zh: 我們還在等面試的結果。

example.en: My parents forbid me to stay out after ten o'clock.
example.zh: 父母禁止我十點後還在外面。

example.en: The roof began to leak during the heavy rain last night.
example.zh: 昨晚大雨時屋頂開始漏水。

example.en: Many young people prefer urban life because of convenient transportation.
example.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡都市生活，因為交通方便。

example.en: Scientists found a new species of frog in the rainforest.
example.zh: 科學家在雨林發現一種新的青蛙物種。

example.en: I did not mean to offend you, so please don't be upset.
example.zh: 我不是故意要冒犯你，所以別生氣。

example.en: Traffic reaches its peak around six o'clock every evening.
example.zh: 每天傍晚六點左右車流達到高峰。

example.en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum, so nobody could hear it.
example.zh: 聲音無法在真空中傳播，所以沒人聽得到。

example.en: We rented a small wooden cabin near the lake for the weekend.
example.zh: 我們週末在湖邊租了一間小木屋。

example.en: Good nutrition is important for children who are growing fast.
example.zh: 對快速成長的孩子來說，良好的營養很重要。

example.en: The large corporation hired five hundred new workers this year.
example.zh: 這家大企業今年僱用了五百名新員工。

example.en: Every living cell in our body needs oxygen to survive.
example.zh: 人體每個活細胞都需要氧氣才能存活。

example.en: She loves reading classic literature from the nineteenth century.
example.zh: 她喜歡閱讀十九世紀的經典文學。

example.en: The school committee will decide on the new uniform next week.
example.zh: 學校委員會下週會決定新制服。

example.en: The bright colors of the new cafe really appeal to young customers.
example.zh: 這家新咖啡廳鮮豔的顏色很吸引年輕顧客。

example.en: Swimmers need strong discipline to train every morning before school.
example.zh: 游泳選手要有很強的自律，每天上學前都得訓練。

example.en: We watched a funny comedy last night and laughed the whole time.
example.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部好笑的喜劇，一直笑個不停。

example.en: Surviving that car accident was a miracle, the doctor said.
example.zh: 醫生說，能在那場車禍中存活是一個奇蹟。

example.en: The audience applauded loudly when the singer finished her last song.
example.zh: 歌手唱完最後一首歌時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

example.en: Many students feel anxiety before final exams.
example.zh: 許多學生在期末考前會感到焦慮。

example.en: The teacher wants to emphasize the importance of reading every day.
example.zh: 老師想強調每天閱讀的重要性。

example.en: She wrapped a clean bandage around the cut on his knee.
example.zh: 她把乾淨的繃帶纏在他膝蓋的傷口上。

example.en: He likes to boast about his high salary to his friends.
example.zh: 他喜歡在朋友面前吹噓自己的高薪。

example.en: We put a soft red carpet in the living room.
example.zh: 我們在客廳鋪了一張柔軟的紅色地毯。

example.en: I never thought my best friend would betray my trust.
example.zh: 我從沒想過我最好的朋友會背叛我的信任。

example.en: The school keeps all student records in a computer database.
example.zh: 學校把所有學生資料存在電腦資料庫裡。

example.en: The merchant sold fresh fruit at the busy market every morning.
example.zh: 這位商人每天早上在熱鬧的市場賣新鮮水果。

example.en: A week in a five-star hotel is a real luxury for us.
example.zh: 在五星級飯店住一週對我們來說是真正的奢侈。

example.en: It was raining hard, and thus we decided to stay home.
example.zh: 外面下大雨，因此我們決定待在家裡。

example.en: Many families in this village still depend on agriculture for a living.
example.zh: 這個村莊的許多家庭仍然靠農業維生。

example.en: My membership at the gym expires at the end of this month.
example.zh: 我在健身房的會員資格會在本月底到期。

example.en: The city has decided to ban smoking in all public parks.
example.zh: 市政府已決定禁止在所有公園內吸菸。

example.en: Every citizen has the right to vote in a democracy.
example.zh: 在民主國家，每位公民都有投票的權利。

example.en: Sunlight came through the window in a bright beam.
example.zh: 陽光以明亮的光束穿過窗戶照進來。

example.en: Before writing the essay, she made a short outline of her ideas.
example.zh: 寫論文之前，她先把想法列成一個簡短的大綱。

example.en: The loud thunder frightened the little dog under the bed.
example.zh: 巨大的雷聲把躲在床底下的小狗嚇到了。

example.en: Scientists are still learning about the origins of the universe.
example.zh: 科學家仍在探索宇宙的起源。

example.en: Our team hopes to defeat the champions in the final game.
example.zh: 我們隊希望在決賽中擊敗冠軍隊伍。

example.en: She ordered a fancy coffee with cream and chocolate on top.
example.zh: 她點了一杯頂端加奶油和巧克力的花俏咖啡。

example.en: The children buried their old toys in the sand at the beach.
example.zh: 孩子們把舊玩具埋在海灘的沙子裡。

example.en: Honesty is an important element of any good friendship.
example.zh: 誠實是任何良好友誼的重要要素。

example.en: My niece is five years old and loves drawing pictures of cats.
example.zh: 我的姪女五歲，很喜歡畫貓的圖畫。

example.en: The diligent student finished all her homework before dinner.
example.zh: 這位勤奮的學生在晚餐前就做完了所有功課。

example.en: The nurse explained the procedure before the doctor started the test.
example.zh: 醫生開始檢查前，護士先解釋了整個流程。

example.en: Grandma taught me how to peel an apple with a small knife.
example.zh: 奶奶教我如何用小刀削蘋果的皮。

example.en: We walked down a quiet lane lined with old trees.
example.zh: 我們走在一條兩旁種滿老樹的安靜小巷裡。

example.en: The team has adequate supplies for the long hike.
example.zh: 這支隊伍有足夠的補給進行長途健行。

example.en: She is a good instance of hard work paying off.
example.zh: 她就是努力終會有回報的好例子。

example.en: My daughter started kindergarten last month and loves her teacher.
example.zh: 我女兒上個月開始上幼兒園，很喜歡她的老師。

example.en: He gave a vague answer when I asked where he had been.
example.zh: 我問他去過哪裡，他的回答含糊不清。

example.en: We visited a historical temple that was built over three hundred years ago.
example.zh: 我們參觀了一座已有三百多年歷史的古寺。

example.en: Never mix this chemical with bleach, because it creates toxic gas.
example.zh: 千萬不要把這種化學物質和漂白水混在一起，會產生有毒氣體。

example.en: The clown's silly tricks always amuse the little kids at the circus.
example.zh: 小丑的滑稽把戲總是逗得馬戲團的小孩很開心。

example.en: My grandfather's vision is getting weaker, so he needs stronger glasses.
example.zh: 爺爺的視力越來越差，所以需要更強的眼鏡。

example.en: Plants release oxygen into the air, which people need to breathe.
example.zh: 植物會把氧氣釋放到空氣中，供人類呼吸。

example.en: Admission to the art museum is free for students on Sundays.
example.zh: 週日學生入場參觀美術館免費。

example.en: The local health authority closed the restaurant after the inspection.
example.zh: 衛生局在檢查後把這家餐廳關閉了。

example.en: Our science teacher showed us a simple experiment with colorful liquids.
example.zh: 科學老師給我們看一個用彩色液體做的簡單實驗。

example.en: Your train ticket is only valid for travel on the day printed on it.
example.zh: 這張火車票只限印在票上的當天有效。

example.en: The family had to abandon their old house after the flood.
example.zh: 洪水過後，這家人只好放棄他們的老房子。

example.en: Travelers must declare any cash over ten thousand dollars at customs.
example.zh: 旅客入關時必須申報超過一萬美元的現金。

example.en: This small orchard yields about two hundred apples every autumn.
example.zh: 這座小果園每年秋天大約產出兩百顆蘋果。

example.en: Sponges absorb water quickly, so they are useful for cleaning spills.
example.zh: 海綿吸水很快，所以很適合用來擦拭溢出的液體。

example.en: The whole town came out to watch the parade on Independence Day.
example.zh: 全鎮的人都出來看獨立紀念日的遊行。

example.en: Please unplug the kitchen appliance before you start cleaning it.
example.zh: 請先拔掉廚房電器的插頭再開始清潔。

example.en: The moon was clearly visible above the mountains last night.
example.zh: 昨晚月亮清楚地掛在山頂上方，看得見。

example.en: You could feel the tension in the room before the exam results were announced.
example.zh: 考試成績公布前，教室裡的氣氛非常緊張。

example.en: The smoke alarm can detect smoke even when there is only a small fire.
example.zh: 即使只是小火，煙霧警報器也能偵測到煙。

example.en: Farmers are busy bringing in the wheat harvest before the rain comes.
example.zh: 農夫在下雨前忙著把小麥收割入倉。

example.en: Could you turn down the volume? The music is too loud for me.
example.zh: 可以把音量調小嗎？音樂對我來說太吵了。

example.en: The company offers a free thirty-day trial before you decide to buy.
example.zh: 公司提供免費三十天試用，之後你再決定是否購買。

example.en: My grandfather loves to talk about philosophy over coffee.
example.zh: 我祖父很愛喝咖啡時聊哲學。

example.en: The little dog likes to chase the ball in the park.
example.zh: 那隻小狗喜歡在公園裡追球。

example.en: Long ago, a brave prince ruled a small kingdom by the sea.
example.zh: 很久以前，一位勇敢的王子統治著一個海邊的小王國。

example.en: The lecture was so dull that half the class fell asleep.
example.zh: 這堂課太無聊，半個班都睡著了。

example.en: Volunteering at the shelter was a meaningful experience for me.
example.zh: 在收容所當志工對我來說是很有意義的經驗。

example.en: The hurricane knocked down trees and cut off power across the town.
example.zh: 颶風吹倒樹木，整個城鎮都停電了。

example.en: We could see the lights of a distant village from the hilltop.
example.zh: 從山頂上可以看見遠方村莊的燈光。

example.en: My parents founded this small bakery twenty years ago.
example.zh: 我父母二十年前創立了這家小麵包店。

example.en: Her coach's kind words always motivate her to train harder.
example.zh: 教練的鼓勵總是激勵她更努力訓練。

example.en: Don't yell at the kids; just talk to them calmly.
example.zh: 別對孩子大吼，冷靜跟他們說就好。

example.en: Language is often a barrier when you travel to a new country.
example.zh: 到新國家旅行時，語言常常是一道障礙。

example.en: Many charities work hard to help families escape poverty.
example.zh: 許多慈善團體努力幫助家庭脫離貧窮。

example.en: The cherry trees bloom every spring along the river.
example.zh: 每年春天，河岸邊的櫻花樹都會開花。

example.en: Cost is an important aspect we should consider before buying a car.
example.zh: 買車前，價格是我們該考慮的重要層面。

example.en: Many fishing boats returned to the harbor before the storm.
example.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，許多漁船已返回港口。

example.en: The constant noise from the construction site made it hard to sleep.
example.zh: 工地不斷傳來的噪音讓人很難入睡。

example.en: Please submit your report to the manager by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前把報告交給經理。

example.en: Would you like a warm beverage with your breakfast today?
example.zh: 今天早餐要不要來杯熱飲？

example.en: My dog is very loyal and waits for me at the door every day.
example.zh: 我的狗非常忠心，每天都在門口等我。

example.en: The students worked in the science laboratory until late afternoon.
example.zh: 學生們在科學實驗室工作到傍晚。

example.en: The journalist decided to quote the mayor's exact words in her article.
example.zh: 記者決定在文章中引用市長的原話。

example.en: The wedding was a private affair, with only close family present.
example.zh: 這場婚禮是私人的事，只有至親到場。

example.en: Police officers arrived to investigate the cause of the fire.
example.zh: 警察趕來調查火災的原因。

example.en: She is very mature for her age and handles problems calmly.
example.zh: 她的年紀雖小卻很成熟，遇事很冷靜。

example.en: Please fold the towels neatly and put them back in the closet.
example.zh: 請把毛巾摺整齊，放回衣櫥。

example.en: We spent a week relaxing on a tropical island.
example.zh: 我們在一座熱帶島嶼上悠閒地度過了一週。

example.en: After the long hike, I had a big appetite for dinner.
example.zh: 爬完長途山路後，我晚餐特別有胃口。

example.en: The nurse cleaned the wound and put on a bandage.
example.zh: 護士清理傷口，然後貼上繃帶。

example.en: The city has a military base near the old airport.
example.zh: 這座城市在舊機場附近有一個軍事基地。

example.en: A small boat floated slowly down the calm river.
example.zh: 一艘小船在平靜的河上緩緩漂流而下。

example.en: Teachers try to engage students with fun games in class.
example.zh: 老師試著用有趣的遊戲吸引學生上課參與。

example.en: Heavy snow in the desert is a rare natural phenomenon.
example.zh: 沙漠下大雪是一種罕見的自然現象。

example.en: The dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
example.zh: 在許多文化中，鴿子是和平的象徵。

example.en: My nephew is learning to ride a bike this summer.
example.zh: 我的外甥今年夏天正在學騎腳踏車。

example.en: My grandfather is keen on gardening and grows roses.
example.zh: 我爺爺很熱衷園藝，還會種玫瑰。

example.en: The guard stayed alert all night to watch the gate.
example.zh: 守衛整夜保持警覺，盯著大門。

example.en: There is a pile of dirty dishes in the sink.
example.zh: 水槽裡有一堆髒盤子。

example.en: Wind turbines generate electricity without producing pollution.
example.zh: 風力發電機可以發電，又不會產生污染。

example.en: Parents must accompany children under twelve to the pool.
example.zh: 十二歲以下的孩童進入游泳池時，家長必須陪同。

example.en: The doctor urged him to quit smoking for his health.
example.zh: 醫生力勸他為了健康戒菸。

example.en: It is hard to cope with stress during final exams.
example.zh: 期末考期間很難應付壓力。

example.en: She got a severe cold and missed two weeks of work.
example.zh: 她得了重感冒，缺席工作兩週。

example.en: The gym is a new facility with modern exercise equipment.
example.zh: 這家健身房是新設施，配備現代化的運動器材。

example.en: She works as a junior designer at a small company.
example.zh: 她在一家小公司擔任資淺設計師。

example.en: The court found the young man innocent of the crime.
example.zh: 法院認定這名年輕人對該罪行無罪。

example.en: My father receives a monthly pension after he retired from his job.
example.zh: 我父親退休後每個月領取退休金。

example.en: Last night I had a nightmare about being chased by a dog.
example.zh: 昨晚我做了一場惡夢，夢到被狗追。

example.en: Please don't scratch the mosquito bites or they will itch more.
example.zh: 別抓蚊子咬的包，不然會更癢。

example.en: Our team needs a better strategy to win the game.
example.zh: 我們隊需要更好的策略才能贏得比賽。

example.en: We spent the afternoon wandering around the old town.
example.zh: 我們花了一個下午在老城區閒逛。

example.en: The novel was adapted into a popular movie last year.
example.zh: 這本小說去年被改編成一部受歡迎的電影。

example.en: Many people risked their lives for liberty during the war.
example.zh: 許多人在戰爭期間為了自由冒著生命危險。

example.en: Please boil the kettle because I want a cup of tea.
example.zh: 請把水壺煮開，我想喝杯茶。

example.en: She writes a weekly column about food for the local newspaper.
example.zh: 她為當地報紙撰寫每週一次的美食專欄。

example.en: My daughter is learning to play a musical instrument after school.
example.zh: 我女兒放學後正在學習演奏一種樂器。

example.en: Scientists analyze the data carefully before they publish any results.
example.zh: 科學家在發表任何結果前會仔細分析資料。

example.en: Our opponent in the final match was much taller than our captain.
example.zh: 決賽中我們的對手比我們隊長高很多。

example.en: The penalty for parking illegally here is a fine of two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 在這裡違規停車的罰款是兩千元。

example.en: The two sisters look alike but their personalities are very different.
example.zh: 這對姊妹長得很像，但個性差很多。

example.en: The hikers found shelter in a small cabin when the storm began.
example.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，健行者在一間小木屋找到避難處。

example.en: The snow will melt quickly once the sun comes out this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午太陽一出來，雪很快就會融化。

example.en: Our success was largely due to the hard work of our volunteers.
example.zh: 我們的成功主要歸功於志工們的努力。

example.en: Doctors advise that you should not drink too much alcohol during pregnancy.
example.zh: 醫生建議懷孕期間不要喝太多酒。

example.en: Children often imitate their parents' behavior without even realizing it.
example.zh: 孩子常常在不自覺中模仿父母的行為。

example.en: Tomorrow is our wedding anniversary so I booked a table at a nice restaurant.
example.zh: 明天是我們的結婚週年紀念日，我已經訂了一家好餐廳的位子。

example.en: Wherever you go in this city you will find friendly people.
example.zh: 無論你走到這座城市的哪裡，都會遇到友善的人。

example.en: The two friends formed a strong bond during their years at college.
example.zh: 這兩位朋友在大學期間建立了深厚的情誼。

example.en: She plans to devote her weekends to volunteering at the animal shelter.
example.zh: 她打算把週末時間投入到動物收容所的志工服務。

example.en: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village far away from the city.
example.zh: 我的祖父母住在遠離城市、安靜的鄉村。

example.en: We still don't have a definite answer about whether the trip will happen.
example.zh: 關於這趟旅行會不會成行，我們還沒有確切的答覆。

example.en: I occasionally visit my hometown but I live in the city now.
example.zh: 我偶爾會回老家看看，但現在住在城市裡。

example.en: The team celebrated their triumph with cheers and a big dinner.
example.zh: 球隊歡呼慶祝他們的勝利，並舉辦了一場盛大的晚餐。

example.en: Children wore colorful costumes to the school Halloween party last night.
example.zh: 孩子們昨晚穿著五顏六色的服裝參加學校的萬聖節派對。

example.en: After hiking all day the children felt hunger and asked for food.
example.zh: 整天健行後，孩子們感到飢餓，開始要東西吃。

example.en: The governor granted the prisoner a pardon after twenty years in jail.
example.zh: 州長在囚犯服刑二十年後赦免了他。

example.en: I can't tolerate noise when I am studying.
example.zh: 我讀書的時候無法忍受噪音。

example.en: The child almost drowned in the swimming pool.
example.zh: 那個小孩在游泳池差點溺水。

example.en: This stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand people.
example.zh: 這座體育場的容納量是五萬人。

example.en: Your plan sounds logical, so let's try it.
example.zh: 你的計畫聽起來很合理，我們就試試看吧。

example.en: The government warned people about the abuse of medicine.
example.zh: 政府警告民眾不要濫用藥物。

example.en: Stir the flour and sugar into a smooth mixture.
example.zh: 把麵粉和糖攪拌成滑順的混合物。

example.en: My grandfather was an immigrant who moved to Canada in 1960.
example.zh: 我的祖父是移民，一九六〇年搬到加拿大。

example.en: Nobody knows the mystery behind the missing painting.
example.zh: 沒有人知道那幅失蹤畫作背後的謎團。

example.en: She writes in her journal every night before bed.
example.zh: 她每天晚上睡前都會寫日記。

example.en: The company cares about the welfare of its workers.
example.zh: 這家公司關心員工的福祉。

example.en: The police managed to capture the thief after a short chase.
example.zh: 警方經過短暫追逐後成功抓到小偷。

example.en: I never lend money to friends, because it is my principle.
example.zh: 我從不借錢給朋友，因為這是我的原則。

example.en: Our ancestors farmed this land more than two hundred years ago.
example.zh: 我們的祖先兩百多年前就在這片土地上務農。

example.en: This factory manufactures car parts for several famous brands.
example.zh: 這間工廠為好幾個知名品牌生產汽車零件。

example.en: He made a fortune by selling software to big companies.
example.zh: 他靠賣軟體給大公司賺了一大筆財富。

example.en: The headline on the front page caught everyone's attention.
example.zh: 頭版的標題引起了大家的注意。

example.en: Each household in our building has its own parking space.
example.zh: 我們大樓的每一戶都有自己的停車位。

example.en: You need a visa to obtain a work permit in this country.
example.zh: 你需要簽證才能在這個國家取得工作許可。

example.en: May God bless you and your family this holiday season.
example.zh: 願上帝在這個假期保佑你和你的家人。

example.en: The sudden drop in temperature brought dramatic changes to the weather.
example.zh: 氣溫突然下降，天氣出現了戲劇性的變化。

example.en: Frankly, I think your new haircut looks great on you.
example.zh: 老實說，我覺得你的新髮型很適合你。

example.en: When the fire alarm rang, a wave of panic spread through the office.
example.zh: 火災警報響起時，辦公室裡瀰漫著一股恐慌。

example.en: People in this town practice many different religions.
example.zh: 這個鎮上的人信奉許多不同的宗教。

example.en: A large lamp hangs from the ceiling in the living room.
example.zh: 客廳的天花板上掛著一盞大吊燈。

example.en: The restaurant serves a generous portion of rice with every meal.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每餐都附上一大份米飯。
